1294.name: Farrot's Nest

west.description: To the west lies The Warrior's Grove.

1294.description:
This snug round chamber is woven entirely from boughs and withies, like
the inside of an enormous nest roofed over and tucked into a cleft in
the rock. The floor is deep in down, moss and old furs, and odd bright
trinkets have been pressed into the weave of the walls. Daylight comes
in through chinks in the weave as thin golden needles. A low, round
doorway opens west onto the Warrior's Grove.

extra_descs.trinkets walls weave:
Someone with a magpie's eye has worked hundreds of small shining things
into the walls: brass buttons, a cracked spectacle lens, rings of copper
wire, a silver thimble. None of them is worth much, but each has been
placed with care.

1297.name: The Warrior's Grove

east.description: To the east lies Farrot's Nest.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Mortis and Sojat's Lounge.

1297.description:
This bare crown of grey rock rises above the forest's eaves, ringed by a
grove of ancient pines that the wind has bent and twisted into fantastic
shapes. The flat bedrock in their midst is scarred with countless nicks
where blades have struck it in practice, and a tall grey stone carved
with names stands at its heart. The wind never stops up here. A woven
doorway in a cleft leads east, a low stone lodge stands to the west, and
a stepped path drops south to the forest.

extra_descs.stone names:
The names are cut deep, one beneath another, dozens of them, each with a
small sword beside it. They are said to be warriors who trained on this
rock and fell in battle, and the newest are still sharp-edged.

1299.name: Mortis and Sojat's Lounge

east.description: To the east lies The Warrior's Grove.

1299.description:
This low, comfortable lodge has been built of fieldstone against the
rock, its beams blackened by years of pipe smoke and hearth fire. Two
enormous, sagging armchairs face a wide fireplace, and the walls are
crowded with old trophies: notched swords, a dented helm, a great tusked
skull and maps marked with faded routes. A scarred table holds a game
board set out for play. The door opens east onto the Warrior's Grove.

extra_descs.trophies skull helm swords:
Every trophy carries a little brass plate engraved with two names,
Mortis and Sojat, and a date long past. The plate beneath the tusked
skull says only: Never Again.

2328.name: Wilderness Way

north.description: To the north lies Wilderness Way.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

2328.description:
Wilderness Way climbs gently out of the forest here between low banks of
turf and flowering gorse. To the south the forest of MiNar stands like a
dark wall across the land, its eaves dense and shadowed. The rutted
track runs on north across open heath under a wide, windy sky, and the
smell of leaf mould gives way to the honeyed scent of the gorse.

2329.name: Wilderness Way

east.description: To the east lies Wilderness Way.

south.description: To the south lies Wilderness Way.

2329.description:
The Way bends here to skirt a stony knoll that rises close beside the
road, its crown ringed with dark, wind-bent pines. Grey boulders spill
from its flank right down to the verge, and the ruts swing wide to avoid
them. The road runs east around the foot of the knoll, and south back
toward the eaves of the great forest.

2330.name: Wilderness Way

north.description: To the north lies Wilderness Way.

west.description: To the west lies Wilderness Way.

2330.description:
A little stream crosses the road here through a culvert of flat stones,
chattering out of the heather on one side and losing itself in reeds on
the other. Cart wheels have worn the culvert's capstones smooth and
pale, and clumps of wild thyme scent the banks. Wilderness Way turns
north here, while the other arm of the bend runs west around the stony
knoll.

2331.name: Wilderness Way

north.description: To the north lies Wilderness Way.

south.description: To the south lies Wilderness Way.

2331.description:
The road runs straight and level here across a strip of rough pasture,
where tussocks of wiry grass and clumps of rushes grow. Close by, the
stony flank of the knoll shows a cleft high up, roofed over with a great
woven mass of boughs like the nest of some enormous bird. The Way
carries on north across the open land and south toward a stone culvert.

2332.name: Wilderness Way

north.description: To the north lies Wilderness Way.

south.description: To the south lies Wilderness Way.

2332.description:
Open heath rolls away on both sides of the road here, purple with
heather and gold with broom. Nothing breaks the wind, which flattens the
heather in long waves and sends cloud shadows racing over the land. The
track is stony and dry, its ruts half filled with sand, and it runs on
north toward a low rise and south toward the stony knoll and the forest
beyond.

2333.name: Wilderness Way

north.description: To the north lies Wilderness Way.

south.description: To the south lies Wilderness Way.

2333.description:
The road tops a low rise here, and from its crest you can see a long way
across the open country. Far off, a single enormous tree lifts its crown
above the land like a green thunderhead, and beyond it a vast sea of
tall, pale grass ripples and shimmers in the wind. Wilderness Way runs
down the far slope to the north and back south across the heath.

2334.name: Wilderness Way

north.description: To the north lies Wilderness Way.

south.description: To the south lies Wilderness Way.

2334.description:
A squat milestone stands at the roadside here, its top worn into a
saddle by travellers who have sat on it to rest. Rings of orange and
grey lichen have crept over most of its face. The heath is giving way to
rougher pasture, and the great tree looms nearer above the land. The
road runs on north toward the tree and south over a gentle rise.

extra_descs.milestone stone:
Under the lichen a carved hand points up the road, above a number of
leagues worn too smooth to read. Only one word can still be made out
beneath it: Garathorm.

2335.name: Wilderness Way

north.description: To the north lies Wilderness Way.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies Wilderness Way.

west.description: To the west lies By The Big Tree.

2335.description:
The road passes beneath the outermost boughs of an enormous tree here,
whose trunk stands just to the west within a ring of old flagstones. To
the east a trampled gap opens in a towering wall of grass, taller than a
mounted rider, that marks the edge of the Grasslands. Wilderness Way
itself runs on north beside the grass and south across the open heath.

2336.name: By The Big Tree

east.description: To the east lies Wilderness Way.

2336.description:
An immense tree towers over this place, its trunk so broad that a dozen
people joining hands could not circle it, and its crown spreading so
wide that its outermost boughs shade the road. Old flagstones have been
laid in a ring about its foot, heaved and tilted by the great roots, and
iron rings for tethering horses are driven into the bark. A weathered
notice board is nailed to the trunk at eye height. Wilderness Way passes
by to the east.

extra_descs.notice board notices:
Most of the notices have faded to blank scraps, but a few can still be
read: a reward for a lost grey mare, a warning about wolves in the tall
grass, and a neat card offering swords for hire, signed with two crossed
blades and the word Rahn.

2337.name: Wilderness Way

north.description: To the north lies Wilderness Way.

south.description: To the south lies Wilderness Way.

2337.description:
Here the road runs along the edge of the Grasslands, where the grass
rises in a sheer, whispering wall higher than a man on horseback. The
wind combs through its tops with a sound like distant surf. Across the
road lies open pasture, studded with thistles and grazed short. The Way
runs north along the wall of grass and south toward the shade of the
great tree.

2338.name: Wilderness Way

east.description: To the east lies Wilderness Way.

south.description: To the south lies Wilderness Way.

2338.description:
The road swings east here to skirt a boggy hollow where a pond of brown
water lies among rushes and yellow flag irises. The ground at the
roadside is soft, and the ruts are brimming with water that mirrors the
passing clouds. Willow scrub grows thickly around the far side of the
pond. The Way leads east along the edge of the tall grass, and south
past the pond's reedy margin.

2339.name: Wilderness Way

north.description: To the north lies Wilderness Way.

west.description: To the west lies Wilderness Way.

2339.description:
Wheel ruts cut deep into the clay where the road turns here, and
generations of carts have worn the bend into a broad, muddy curve. The
grass of the Grasslands leans out over the verge, its stems as thick as
a finger and topped with heavy, nodding heads of seed. The road heads
north along the edge of the grass and west toward a reedy pond.

2340.name: Wilderness Way

north.description: To the north lies Wilderness Way.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies Wilderness Way.

2340.description:
A broad opening has been trampled into the wall of grass beside the road
here, and a beaten path plunges east into the green-gold dimness of the
Grasslands. The road itself is wider and better kept along this stretch,
with a ditch dug along one verge. Wilderness Way runs on north toward
the Plains, and south along the edge of the grass.

2341.name: Wilderness Way

north.description: To the north lies Road Through The Plains.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies Wilderness Way.

2341.description:
Wilderness Way comes down off the open plains here, a rutted cart track
pressed between drifts of yellow-flowered gorse. North, the road climbs
back toward the Plains under a wide and windy sky, and south the Way
runs on along the edge of the grass country. East, the grass grows
suddenly enormous, a wall of green stems taller than a mounted rider,
and a trodden gap leads in among them. A leaning post of grey oak marks
the crossing, its carved arrow worn almost smooth.

extra_descs.post leaning oak arrow:
The old oak post leans with the wind. A carved arrow points toward the
giant grass, and beneath it someone has scratched the word RAHN and a
small crossed-swords mark, newer than the rest.

14500.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14500.description:
Light comes in from two sides at once in this corner of the forest, for
the eaves lie only a few steps to the north and to the west. The trees
here are stunted and bent by the wind, their crowns all leaning the same
way, and bracken grows lush in the brightness beneath them. A salt smell
drifts in from the open heath. The forest deepens to the south and east.

14501.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14501.description:
A weathered wooden post stands among the bracken just inside the eaves,
its arms long broken off and only peg holes left to show that it was
ever a signpost. Birches grow here, their white trunks bright against
the darker forest to the south. The open country is very close to the
north, and the wind reaches in to stir the ferns. Trails lead east and
west along the inside of the eaves.

14502.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14502.description:
Bracken grows waist-high just inside the eaves, a sea of green fronds
that hides the ground and rustles at every step. The trees are tall and
widely spaced, mostly oak and birch, and the sky shows bright through
the gaps to the north, where the forest ends. Faint trails part the
bracken east and west, and the ferns run on south into deeper shade. A
sweet, dusty smell rises from the fronds wherever they are brushed.

14503.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14503.description:
Heather has crept in under the trees from the heath outside, mingling
with the bracken in a tangle of purple and green. The trees here are
birch and rowan, light and airy, and the brightness of the open land
shows between them to the west. A path leads east into taller ferns, and
the edge of the forest runs north and south. The wind sets the birch
leaves trembling.

14504.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14504.description:
A muddy wallow lies in a dip among the ferns here, churned by cloven
hooves and rimmed with tufts of russet hair snagged on the brambles
where red deer come to roll and cool themselves. The earth around it
smells rank and sour. The ferns are shoulder-high and heavy with dew.
The way north leads toward the edge of the forest, and from the south
comes the soft trickle of a spring.

14505.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14505.description:
The stump of an enormous tree rises from the ferns here, cut flat long
ago and now crusted with grey and orange lichens. Its rings are far too
many to count, and the axe marks around its edge have softened into
shallow grooves. Lady ferns crowd about its base, their lacy fronds pale
green in the shade. A deer track runs north and south past the stump,
and the wood stretches away east and west.

14506.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14506.description:
A wind-thrown pine lies here with its shallow roots in the air, a rare
dark conifer among the birches, and its fallen needles have turned the
ground beneath it a rusty brown. The land slopes gently east toward a
spring hidden in the ferns. Daylight from the open heath brightens the
trees to the west. The way north and south keeps along the inside of the
forest's edge.

14507.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14507.description:
Here a spring wells up from beneath a moss-covered boulder into a round
stone basin, and spills over its lip to begin a brook that runs away
south. The basin looks too regular to be natural, as if hands shaped it
long ago. Ferns crowd every side, glistening in the damp air. The water
is ice-cold and tastes faintly of stone, and paths lead north, east and
west through the ferns.

extra_descs.basin spring stone carved leaves:
The basin is cut from a single block of grey stone, its rim worn smooth
and dished on one side, as if by countless lips and hands. A band of
carved leaves runs around the rim, so worn that you find it more by
touch than by sight.

14508.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14508.description:
The ground dips here toward a mossy bank where hart's-tongue ferns grow
in glossy, strap-shaped clumps. From just to the west comes the cool
trickle of running water, and the air is noticeably damper. Ferns of a
dozen kinds fill the spaces between slim ash trees, their tips dripping
after the least shower. The forest continues north and south, and grows
darker and older to the east.

14509.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14509.description:
A long, straight-sided pit lies among the ferns here, an old
woodcutters' sawpit where one man once stood below and one above to rip
logs into planks. It is half full of leaves now, and ferns sprout from
its walls. Hawthorns bent by the sea wind line the edge of the forest to
the west. The brook runs close by to the east, and the way leads north
and south.

14510.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14510.description:
Still young here, the brook is narrow enough to step across, and it runs
south between undercut banks where tree roots dangle into the water like
pale threads. The ground on either side is spongy with moss and fern.
Its source, a spring, rises just to the north. To the east a fallen
birch lies across the ferns, and the forest runs on west toward the
light at its edge.

14511.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14511.description:
A fallen birch lies across the ferns here, its white bark peeling in
papery curls and its wood gone soft as cheese. Bracket fungi have
sprouted along its length in neat rows, like steps up the trunk. Through
the ferns to the west you can hear a brook chattering over stones. The
ground is soft and springy underfoot, and the way runs north and south
between slender trees, with deeper forest to the east.

14512.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14512.description:
Low, broad oaks grow here near the edge of the forest, their branches
swept all one way by years of wind from the sea, and grey-green lichen
hangs from them in long beards. The ground is a mix of moss and short
ferns. The brook can be heard splashing over a little fall to the east.
The heath lies just beyond the trees to the west, and the forest runs on
north and south.

14513.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14513.description:
The brook drops over a ledge of dark rock here in a small, noisy fall no
higher than your knee, and churns into a pool of foam before running on
south. Ferns lean over the water from both banks, their fronds beaded
with spray. A badger path crosses the brook just below the fall. The
ferns go on north and west, and the forest grows older to the east.

14514.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14514.description:
Mounds of sandy earth spill from a row of holes dug beneath the roots of
a towering ash, where badgers have tunnelled their sett for generations.
Their paths are worn bare through the ferns, and a fallen branch nearby
is scored with claw marks. The brook murmurs close by to the west. The
forest runs on north and south through tall fronds, and eastward into
deeper shade.

14515.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14515.description:
The old ride begins here just inside the forest's edge, its mouth half
choked with dead, silvered branches piled in heaps as if gathered by
many hands and then abandoned. A cold, damp breath of air seems to come
from somewhere near. The eaves lie to the north, the ride runs south
into the forest, and the woods are open east among hazels and west into
bracken.

14516.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14516.description:
A long, straight ride runs through the forest here, a grassy lane cut in
some long-forgotten age and still kept open by the passing of deer. Huge
wych elms line it on both sides, their rough-barked limbs meeting
overhead in a high green vault. The ride runs north and south, and gaps
between the elms lead east and west.

14517.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14517.description:
A grove of old hollies grows here, so dense overhead that the ground
beneath is dry and bare even after rain. Their trunks are smooth and
pale, and the shade under them is deep and still, sheltered from the
wind off the heath. Outside the grove, ferns crowd up to the edge of the
forest to the west. Stepping stones cross the brook a little way east,
and the way runs north and south.

14518.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14518.description:
A clear brook runs south here over a bed of brown pebbles, and a line of
flat stepping stones crosses it, each one worn smooth and dished in the
middle. Watercress grows in the slack water by the banks. On one side
the ferns are tall and thick, and on the other a lawn of moss leads east
toward a round pond. The brook can be followed north toward its source.

14519.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14519.description:
The ferns thin out here around a small, round pond that fills the pit
where some great tree was torn up by its roots long ago. Marsh marigolds
blaze yellow along its edges, and its still surface holds a perfect
picture of the leaves above. Old oaks lean in around the clearing as if
to admire themselves. The ferns lie north, the brook runs close by to
the west, and the wood grows older and mossier to the south and east.

14520.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14520.description:
A deer path crosses the old ride here, a narrow, hoof-pocked track
coming out of the ferns on one side and vanishing among the trees on the
other. The ride itself is a long, straight lane of short grass and moss
between old elms, running north and south. The deer path leads west, and
east toward the lip of a deep gully.

14521.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14521.description:
Here the ride begins to run along the rim of a gully, which opens beside
it as a narrow cleft and widens as it goes. Mist rises from it in slow
wisps, beading the grass of the ride with damp. Tall elms lean out over
the edge. The ride runs north and south, and a path leads west into the
woods.

14522.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14522.description:
The brook flows west here toward the forest's edge, broadening into a
shallow ford over pale sand where the water ripples ankle-deep. Alders
lean over it, their roots knotted along the banks. Through the thinning
trees to the west, the stream runs out onto the open heath. Upstream the
brook bends away east toward a deep pool, and the forest runs on north
and south.

14523.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14523.description:
The brook that runs down from the north swings sharply west here,
scouring a deep pool at the bend where the water turns slowly, dark and
clear. A bar of pale gravel has built up on the inside of the curve.
Royal ferns stand tall on the banks, and the boulders around are thick
with moss. The forest continues east and south, and the brook leads away
west toward the edge of the trees.

14524.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14524.description:
Boulders lie scattered among the oaks here, each so thickly cushioned
with moss that its shape has softened into a smooth green hump. Moss
climbs the trunks as well, and hangs in pale beards from the lower
branches. The voice of the brook carries from the west, where it bends
away toward the edge of the forest. Ferns lie north, and the mossy wood
goes on south and east in deep, green quiet.

14525.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14525.description:
Honeysuckle twines up the trunks of young oaks near the edge of the
forest here, and its scent hangs heavy and sweet in the shelter of the
trees. Dog roses scramble through the undergrowth, catching at sleeves.
Light from the heath brightens the way to the west. Eastward lies the
broken crown of a fallen giant, and the forest runs on north toward the
brook and south into mossier ground.

14526.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14526.description:
The broken crown of a fallen giant oak fills this part of the forest, a
tangle of great limbs, snapped branches and dead leaves that you must
clamber around. Its mossy trunk stretches away to the east, as long as a
barn. Ferns and seedlings have begun to claim the wreckage. The brook
can be heard to the north, and the way south leads toward a ring of
standing stones.

14527.description:
A giant oak has fallen here, and its trunk lies across the forest floor
higher than your head, furred with moss and sprouting a row of seedlings
along its spine. Its torn roots rear up in a great disc of earth on one
side, while its broken crown sprawls among the trees to the west. A gap
where its branches snapped lets you pass north and south. The air under
the canopy is still and heavy, and every sound seems to sink into the
moss.

14528.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14528.description:
Cushion moss has grown into great soft mounds between the trees here,
some as high as your knee, in every shade of green from almost yellow to
almost black. Rotting stumps stand among them, shelved with bracket
fungi as broad as plates. A strange stillness hangs over the wood to the
east, where a ring of stones stands among the trees. The edge of the
forest lies west, and the way runs north and south.

14529.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14529.description:
Nine stones stand in a ring among the trees here, none taller than a
man's shoulder, each so thick with moss that they look like hooded
figures gathered in council. No tree grows inside the ring, though the
forest crowds right up to its edge, and the moss within is short and
fine as a lawn. The air is utterly still. The way runs north and south
past the circle, and the forest stretches east and west.

extra_descs.stones ring nine circle standing:
The stones are rough and unshaped, but each has been set upright with
care, and every one leans very slightly inward. The tallest has a hollow
the size of a cupped hand worn into its top, and it always seems to hold
a little rainwater.

14530.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14530.description:
An ancient ash has split near its base into three great trunks, each as
thick as an ordinary tree, that rise and lean apart like the prongs of a
fork. Deep moss covers the ground so evenly that your feet sink in
without a sound, and here and there it is pressed into hollows where
deer have bedded down. Ivy wraps the lower trunks in dark green coils.
The mossy forest stretches away on every side, as quiet as a shut room.

14531.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14531.description:
The old mossy wall that crosses the forest comes to an end here, running
out from under the trees to the west and fading into a line of grassy
stones on the heath beyond. Its last stretch is little more than a hump
of moss with a few stones showing through. The wall leads away east
toward a pair of standing gateposts. The forest continues north, and
south the ground begins to fall gently away.

14532.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14532.description:
Two tall gateposts of grey stone still stand in the old mossy wall here,
though the gate that once hung between them rotted away an age ago. One
post bears a carving half hidden beneath the moss. The wall runs away
east and west through the trees, broken and green, and the gap between
the posts leads south. North, the forest is deep and silent around a
ring of standing stones.

extra_descs.gateposts gatepost post carving hand:
When you scrape the moss aside, the carving on the gatepost proves to be
an open hand, palm outward, as if to say stop. Below it are a few
angular marks that might once have been letters, worn now past reading.

14533.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14533.description:
An old dry-stone wall crosses the forest here, so ancient and so
swallowed by moss that it looks more like a long green bank than
anything built by hands. Trees have grown up through it, and their roots
have shouldered whole stretches down into heaps of stones. A gap lets
the way pass south, and the wall runs on west through the trees. To the
north the moss-hung oaks stand close and silent.

14534.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14534.description:
Through a gap in the trees to the west, a tall standing stone can be
seen leaning on the open heath just outside the forest. Inside the eaves
the ground is a mix of moss and heather, and a single silver birch
stands pale in a small glade. To the east the branches of a great yew
sweep down to the ground. The way runs north toward the old wall and
south between oaks.

14535.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14535.description:
An enormous yew grows here, so old that its trunk has split and hollowed
into a ring of separate pillars, and you could walk right into the dark
space at its heart. Its branches sweep down to the ground all round,
making a dim, red-brown chamber of needles and bark. The old mossy wall
runs close by to the north. Beyond the yew's shade, the forest continues
south, east and west.

extra_descs.yew hollow heart pillars:
Inside the hollow yew the light is dim and reddish, and the air smells
of resin. The inner walls of the trunk are smooth and dry, polished by
the shoulders of whatever has sheltered here, and the floor is a soft
bed of old needles.

14536.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14536.description:
Wild garlic carpets the ground here between tall, straight ash trees,
its broad leaves and starry white flowers filling the air with a sharp
green smell. The old mossy wall lies just to the north, broken down
where the way passes through it. The forest floor dips gently toward the
south. The canopy is high and light, and the ash leaves flutter at the
faintest breath of wind.

14537.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14537.description:
A dead pine stands here like a grey spire among the living trees,
stripped bare by the years, its bark lying heaped about its foot in
curling plates. Its branches are short stubs, silvered by the weather.
The ground around it is soft with needles and moss, and the edge of the
forest shows bright to the west, where blackthorn crowds the eaves.
Bluebells haze the ground to the east, and the way runs north and south.

14538.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14538.description:
Bluebells carpet the ground under the oaks here, so thickly that the
forest floor seems wreathed in a haze of blue smoke. Their scent is
faint and sweet in the still air. The oaks are huge and ancient, their
lower limbs as thick as ordinary trees and furred with moss. The way
runs north toward a great yew, and the wood continues south, east and
west.

14539.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14539.description:
Grey rock shows through the trees to the east, where the ground rises
toward the foot of a long scarp of crags. Boulders that tumbled from it
long ago lie half buried in the forest floor, green with moss and fern.
Ash and wych elm grow here, their leaves pale against the stone. The
forest runs on north and south, and the moss-hung trees grow thicker to
the west.

14540.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14540.description:
The ground dips into a shallow hollow here, and the mist that drifts in
from the heath settles in it like water in a basin, hiding your feet. An
oak strangled by ivy stands at its rim, more ivy than tree. The ruined
foundations of an old lodge lie a little way east. The edge of the
forest is close to the west, and the way runs north toward drier ground
and south into a damper wood.

14541.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14541.description:
Low lines of mossy stones mark out the foundations of a small building
here, a forester's lodge perhaps, long since fallen and forgotten. A
broad hearthstone still lies at one end, cracked across, with a holly
growing up through the crack. Of the chimney nothing remains but a
tumbled heap. The forest closes round on every side, and paths lead off
north and south among the oaks.

14542.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14542.description:
A single shaft of sunlight falls through a gap in the canopy here,
lighting a mossy stump so brightly that it seems to glow against the
shadows. Around it the forest is old and hushed, its floor deep in moss
and the brown skeletons of last year's leaves. The great stepped blocks
of the scarp rise through the trees to the east. Ways lead north and
south between the trunks, and west into the moss-hung wood.

14543.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14543.description:
A moss-grown marker stone stands beside the ride here, waist-high and
carved on one face with a leaping stag. Beyond it the ground drops
steeply into a gully, its bottom hidden in mist and ferns. The grassy
ride runs north and south between rows of ancient elms, and a path leads
west into the trees.

extra_descs.marker stone stag:
The stag is carved in a flowing, old-fashioned style, its antlers
branching out into leaves. Below it, almost lost under the moss, is a
small carved crown, the sign of some long-forgotten royal forest.

14544.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14544.description:
An old ditch runs along the inside of the eaves here, dug by forgotten
hands and now brimming with black water and drowned leaves. Ferns arch
over it from both banks. Mist drifts in from the open land beyond the
trees to the west and lies in grey sheets between the birches. A rough
plank bridges the ditch, and the way goes on north, south and east.

14545.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14545.description:
Mist hangs among the trees so thickly here that the trunks fade from
dark to grey to nothing within a few paces. Every leaf drips, and the
sound of the drops is the only sound there is. Underfoot the moss is
sodden and cold. A tumbled line of stones to the north marks the ruins
of an old lodge, and the way leads east, west and south into the white.

14546.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14546.description:
Here the mossy wood begins to slope gently downward, and the first wisps
of mist creep up through the trees from the low, wet ground to the
south. Old ash trees stand well apart, their trunks green with moss on
one side only. To the east the scarp leans out over a shallow rock
shelter. The forest runs north among older trees and west into growing
dimness.

14547.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14547.description:
Hazel bushes crowd together under the oaks here, and the ground beneath
them is littered with nutshells split neatly in half by the teeth of
squirrels. Mist from the heath drifts through their thin, straight
stems. To the west the eaves are close, and the ruts of an old cart
track run along the outside of the forest. The way leads north, south
and east through dripping trees.

14548.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14548.description:
Pale birches stand in ranks here, their papery bark peeling in long
curls and their tops lost in mist. The ground between them is a quilt of
red and green bog moss that squelches with every step, and water wells
up into each footprint. A boulder fallen from the cliffs lies wrapped in
roots to the east. The way leads north, south and west through the
dripping trees.

14549.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14549.description:
A boulder that rolled from the scarp long ago lies here among the trees,
and a birch has grown right over it, its roots draped down every side of
the stone like a net. Mist hangs low beneath the canopy. The jumble of
the rockfall lies to the east at the foot of the cliffs. The way leads
north and south through the damp wood, and west toward the forest's
misty heart.

14550.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14550.description:
Fire once crept in from the heath here and scorched the edge of the
forest, and the lower trunks of the oaks are still black with char. New
growth has come up thick in the burned ground, young birch and
willowherb crowding toward the light. The smell of old ash lingers
whenever the ground is wet. The way runs north and south, and east into
hanging webs.

14551.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14551.description:
Old cobwebs hang in grey curtains from the lower branches of the hollies
here, sagging with mist and the husks of dead leaves they have caught.
Some are thick enough to tear with a sound like ripping cloth. The
ground is wet and dark, and the mist moves slowly between the trunks.
Firmer ground rises to the east, and the way runs north, south and west.

14552.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14552.description:
The ground rises a little here into a hummock of firm earth where three
old oaks grow close together, their roots locked in a single tangle.
Mist pools in the hollows on every side, and the lower branches drip
steadily. Through the trees to the east, the scarp shows grey and
streaked with white where owls have long roosted on its ledges. The way
runs north and south, and west deeper into the misty wood.

14553.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14553.description:
Wood sorrel grows in a bright green carpet under the trees here, its
clover-like leaves folded shut against the damp. The mist is thinner
near the edge of the forest, and the tumbled walls of some old dwelling
show through the trunks to the west. To the east, a path of split logs
begins its crossing of the marsh. The way runs north and south through
the mossy wood.

14554.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14554.description:
A path of split logs laid side by side begins here and runs south across
soft, wet ground into the mist, each log half sunk in black mud and
green with slime. Someone built it long ago to cross the marsh around a
hidden mere, and most of it still holds. Alders grow on the firmer
ground to the north. The way also leads east toward the sound of falling
water and west deeper into the misty wood.

14555.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar
