east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14555.description:
The sound of falling water comes through the trees from the east, where
a thin cascade drops from the top of the scarp. Alders grow here in wet
ground, their roots raised in arches above black pools, and moss hangs
from every branch. The mist thickens to the south toward a hidden mere.
The way north leads onto higher, drier ground, and a path of split logs
begins to the west.

14556.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14556.description:
Yellow flag irises grow in a tall thicket here, where the marsh around
the mere reaches the drier ground near the forest's edge. Their sword-
shaped leaves rattle in the breeze that comes in off the heath to the
west. To the east lies the black water of the mere, with a log causeway
running along its shore. Firm ground leads north and south.

14557.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14557.description:
The log path runs out here along the shore of a dark mere, its still
water stretching away into the mist, black and smooth as polished stone.
Reeds rattle softly around the logs, and now and then bubbles rise from
the depths and burst with a smell of rotting leaves. The causeway
continues north and south. To east and west the marsh grows boggier,
though firm tussocks lead that way.

14558.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14558.description:
Bog myrtle grows thickly on the wet ground here, and every brush against
its leaves releases a sharp, sweet, resinous smell. Through the mist to
the west lies the dark water of a mere, rimmed with reeds. Pale fingers
of vapour curl up from the ground and drift between the birches. The way
north and south follows a ridge of drier earth, and the carved face of
the scarp shows faintly to the east.

14559.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14559.description:
A slow, dark stream creeps out of the mere to the east and winds away
west under the trees, so sluggish that its surface barely moves. Its
banks are deep in rotting leaves and spongy moss. Yews grow dark and
close here, and the mist gathers thick between them. The way runs north
and south across the stream by a fallen log.

14560.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14560.description:
A drowned oak stands knee-deep in the mere here, long dead and bleached
grey, its bare branches reaching up into the mist. The log causeway
passes close beside it, bending around the shore of the dark water.
Cotton grass nods on the wet ground, and the air is cold and smells of
peat. The causeway leads north and south, while reeds and sedge stretch
east and west along the shore.

14561.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14561.description:
Reeds and tall sedges rise around you here at the edge of a dark mere,
whose still water shows through the mist to the west. The ground quakes
faintly underfoot, a crust of moss and roots over deep mud, and the air
smells of rot and peat. Firmer ground leads north and south along the
shore, and the rocky scarp lies east beyond a screen of alders.

14562.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14562.description:
A huge beech trunk lies here, fallen so long ago that its heart has
rotted out, leaving a hollow log big enough to crawl through from end to
end. Moss and fungus cover it, and ferns grow along its top like a
crest. Mist drifts in from the west, where the forest ends among
hollies. The way leads north and south, and east toward the end of an
old log causeway.

14563.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14563.description:
The log causeway ends here at the edge of firmer ground, its last few
logs rotted through and sinking into the mud. The mist is thinner, and a
damp wood of alder and holly closes in. North, the causeway heads back
toward the dark mere. To the east, webs hang heavy among the yews, and
the way also leads south and west between the trees.

14564.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14564.description:
Webs as wide as cartwheels are strung between the yews here, beaded with
mist so that every thread hangs heavy with silver drops. The dry husks
of moths and beetles dangle in them like strange fruit. The ground is
dark with fallen needles, and the scarp rises close by to the east. The
way runs north and south, and the mist grows thicker to the west.

14565.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14565.description:
Tall pines with flaking red bark grow near the forest's edge here, and
the warm smell of their resin mingles with salt carried in on the wind.
The ground is soft and sandy, deep in fallen needles and cones. Beyond
the eaves to the west the land drops away out of sight. A wild apple
tree grows to the east, and the way runs north and south among the
pines.

14566.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14566.description:
A great old apple tree, gone wild and grey with lichen, grows here among
the alders, its gnarled branches hung with bunches of mistletoe. Someone
must have planted it long ago, though no other trace of them remains.
Mist drifts in thin strands between the trunks. The way leads north
toward a log causeway, and the wood runs on east, west and south.

14567.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14567.description:
Old grey willows sprawl across the ground here, their trunks lying flat
where they fell and sending up new shoots like rows of green spears.
Pools of standing water reflect the pale mist that hangs among them. The
foot of a rocky scarp shows through the trees to the east. The way north
and south keeps to firmer ground between the pools, and the misty wood
spreads west.

14568.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14568.description:
In this last corner of the forest the trees are mostly pines and firs,
leaning away from the sea wind with their roots gripping a thin, stony
soil. The eaves lie close to both the south and the west, and the light
between the trunks is bright and grey. The dull roar of surf rises from
somewhere below the cliffs beyond. The misty wood lies north and east.

14569.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14569.description:
The ground rises out of the damp here, and gorse and broom have crept in
under the trees from the open land to the south, bright yellow against
the dark trunks. The mist thins to a faint haze, and the air smells of
sun-warmed broom. A misty, dripping wood lies north, and the way runs
east and west along the inside of the eaves.

14570.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14570.description:
Mist drifts between slender alders here, thinning toward the south,
where the trees end and pale daylight shows. A little burn comes in from
the hills that way and loses itself in the soft ground, spreading into
brown pools between tussocks of sedge. An ivy-covered crag rises among
the trees to the east. The wood runs north into deeper mist and west
along the inside of the eaves.

14571.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14571.description:
The gully that has followed the ride grows shallow here, its steep sides
slumping into a broad, fern-choked hollow where water stands among the
fronds. Beyond it the ground flattens into the reeds of a fen. The ride
runs north along the gully's rim and south toward a causeway of logs,
and the woods are open to the west.

14572.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14572.description:
An old causeway of split logs leaves the ride here and runs east across
the soft ground at the head of the fen, its timbers green with moss and
sunk half into the mud. Someone laid it long ago so that riders could
cross dry-shod. The grassy ride itself runs north and south, and the
forest is open west among moss-cushioned boulders.

extra_descs.causeway logs timbers:
The logs are oak, split and laid side by side, and pegged at their ends
to stakes driven deep into the mud. Most are sound still, though here
and there one has rotted through and sunk, leaving a gap full of brown
water.

14573.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14573.description:
Birch saplings have seeded themselves thickly along this stretch of the
ride, crowding the old grassy lane until it is barely wide enough to
walk. Their white stems stand at the edge of the fen, where the ground
turns soft and the reeds begin. The ride runs north toward a log
causeway and south between the birches, and a path leads west into older
woods.

14574.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14574.description:
An ancient bank and ditch runs beside the ride here, holding back the
wet ground of the fen, so worn and overgrown that it is little more than
a long green hump. Rushes fill the ditch, and beyond the bank the reeds
stretch away grey-green and whispering. The ride runs north and south,
and the forest is open to the west.

14575.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14575.description:
An old mossy wall comes in through the trees from the west and ends
against the ride here, its last stones tumbled into the grass. On the
other side of the ride the fen stretches away in a waste of reeds and
black pools, and the air is heavy with the smell of rotting stems. The
ride runs north along the fen's edge and south toward a ford.

14576.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14576.description:
The old ride comes to an end here at a ford, where a brown brook running
out of the fen crosses the way and a line of stepping stones leads east
over the water. Willows lean low over the stream, trailing their leaves
in it. The ride runs back north along the edge of the fen, the ground
rises toward grey rock to the south, and the woods are open west.

14577.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14577.description:
The forest floor ends here against the first rise of a grey scarp, a
wall of weathered rock that climbs higher and higher as it runs south.
Ivy and polypody ferns cling to its ledges, and its foot is littered
with mossy stones. The way follows the base of the rock south, while the
forest continues north and opens west among ash and elm. Water seeps
from a crack in the stone, darkening it in a long stripe.

14578.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14578.description:
The scarp rises to twice a man's height here, its face broken into
massive square blocks like the steps of a stair built for giants, though
none of them could be climbed. A yew has taken root at its foot and
grown sideways along the rock, twisted into knots by its long struggle
for light. The path runs north and south beneath the stone, and the
forest lies west. It is cool here, and the air smells of wet rock and
yew needles.

14579.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14579.description:
The scarp leans outward above the path here, forming a shallow overhang
where travellers have long sheltered from the rain. Its ceiling is
blackened with the soot of countless small fires, and a ring of fire-
cracked stones sits on the dry earth beneath it. Beyond its shelter the
forest drips and rustles. The way runs north and south along the foot of
the rock, and the trees open to the west.

extra_descs.overhang ceiling soot marks scratches:
Among the soot, people have scratched marks into the rock with knives
and charred sticks: tally lines, a crude stag, a name or two, and an
arrow pointing back along the scarp. The newest marks lie over older
ones, layer upon layer, like a page written over too many times.

14580.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14580.description:
A rockfall has spilled from the scarp here, burying its foot under a
jumble of angular boulders, some as big as wagons. Moss and fern have
softened the heap, but the gaps between the stones are deep and dark,
and you must pick your way with care. The path winds through the jumble
north and south, and the forest is easier going to the west. A few
stunted birches have rooted among the stones.

14581.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14581.description:
High on the face of the scarp, a rowan grows straight out of a crack,
its berries hanging scarlet over the drop. Below it the ledges are
streaked white where owls have roosted for years, and the ground at the
foot of the rock is scattered with grey pellets of fur and tiny bones.
The path keeps to the base of the cliff, running north and south. The
forest to the west is dim and close.

14582.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14582.description:
A thin thread of water falls from the top of the scarp here, unravelling
into spray long before it reaches the stony pool at its foot. The rock
behind it is slick and green, and the ferns around the pool shiver in
the cool draught the falling water makes. Stepping stones carry the path
across the pool's overflow, north and south along the cliff. The forest
lies west, dim and dripping.

14583.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14583.description:
The face of the scarp has been worn smooth here by the weather, and
someone in ages past chose it for carving. Spirals and branching lines
run across the stone, along with the unmistakable outline of a great
antlered stag, all softened by moss creeping in from the edges. The
ground before the carvings is bare and trodden. The path continues north
and south under the rock, and the wood stretches away west.

extra_descs.carvings spirals stag carving rock:
The stag is life-sized, its antlers spreading across the rock in grooves
as deep as a finger. Around it the spirals turn inward like whirlpools,
and the stag's carved flank has been rubbed dark and smooth, as if by a
great many hands.

14584.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14584.description:
A deep fissure splits the scarp from top to bottom here, far too narrow
for anyone to squeeze into. Cold air breathes steadily out of it,
carrying a smell of wet stone and the faint, far-off sound of dripping
somewhere inside the rock. Hart's-tongue ferns grow thickly around its
mouth, fed by the damp. The path runs north and south along the cliff,
and the forest opens to the west.

14585.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14585.description:
The scarp is lower here, and dark yews cling along its top, their roots
pouring over the edge in a knotted cascade. Beneath them the path is
carpeted with fallen red needles and the hard husks of yew berries. Mist
creeps in among the trees from the low, damp wood to the west. North the
cliff climbs steadily higher, and south it bends sharply away.

14586.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14586.description:
Here the scarp bends at a sharp angle and runs off east, its face lower
and more broken, with a twisted hawthorn growing in the very corner of
the rock. A path follows its foot that way beneath beeches, while the
taller cliffs climb away north. The trees thin a little to the south,
where the forest's edge is near, and a misty, low-lying wood spreads to
the west.

14587.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14587.description:
A last outlying crag of the scarp stands here, no higher than a cottage
roof, so thickly clothed in ivy that it looks like a green mound with a
stunted oak on top. The forest's edge lies just to the south, and wind
from the hills stirs the leaves. A path runs north toward the corner of
the cliffs, and others lead east among great beeches and west into a
quiet, misty wood.

14588.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14588.description:
The rock wall dwindles here into a steep bank of earth and stones, held
together by a mesh of roots. A storm once tore through this part of the
forest, and fallen trunks lie at all angles, some still caught leaning
in the arms of their neighbours. Brambles and young birches have sprung
up in the light the storm let in. Paths pick their way through the
wreckage east, west and south.

14589.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14589.description:
This is the heart of the storm's damage, where whole ranks of trees were
thrown down together, and their great discs of roots now stand on edge,
taller than a house. Rainwater fills the craters they tore from the
ground, black and still. The sky is open overhead, and willowherb and
bramble have claimed the light. A way leads east toward a cleft in the
rocky ridge, and others wind west and south among the fallen trunks.

14590.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14590.description:
Beeches grow hard against the foot of a low rock wall here, and their
roots have gripped the stone like the fingers of giants, flowing over it
in smooth grey coils and prising it apart. The ground between them is a
lattice of more roots, and you must step high to cross it. The way runs
east and west along the base of the rock, and the trees open southward
toward the edge of the forest.

14591.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14591.description:
Rock walls close in on both sides until the ravine is barely wider than
a cart, and the sky is only a ragged strip of green and light far above.
Every footstep comes back twice from the stone. Water drips from
overhanging ledges, and the floor is a bed of wet moss and stones. The
ravine ends a little way to the north, and widens again as it runs
south.

14592.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14592.description:
The ravine ends here in a tall wall of rock that weeps water from a
hundred cracks, so that its whole face glistens and drips. At its foot
the water has gathered into a round, clear pool lined with green stones,
cold enough to numb the hand. A rowan leans from a ledge above it, and
the walls on every side are far too steep and slick to climb. The only
way out is back south along the ravine.

14593.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14593.description:
An enormous beech stands here on roots that arch above the ground like
the buttresses of a temple, and between two of them someone has woven a
low shelter of hazel sticks, long abandoned and grown through with ivy.
The forest floor is a tangle of smaller roots and beech-mast. The light
is brighter to the south, where the forest ends, and the trees continue
north, east and west.

14594.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14594.description:
Fallen trees from an old storm lie thick here, and the way passes
beneath one great beech that came down across two others, forming a low,
dark arch of grey bark. Young birches crowd the gaps in a pale thicket,
and brambles snatch at your legs. To the south the forest ends and the
light grows brighter. Ways lead north into the worst of the wreckage,
and east and west through the trees.

14595.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14595.description:
The remains of an old sunken track run south out of the forest here, its
banks lined with roots and its bed choked with fern and bramble. Few
feet have used it in years. To the north, fallen trees lie in a tangle
where a storm once flattened the wood, and the forest runs on east and
west among younger growth. A squat marker stone stands beside the track,
its letters long since worn away.

14596.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14596.description:
The ravine deepens here, and its rock wall towers overhead, streaked
with dark seepage and tufted with ferns in every crack. On the opposite
side a steep slope of roots and earth climbs up into the forest to the
east. Fallen leaves have drifted deep in the ravine's bed and rustle
around your ankles. The way narrows to the north and widens toward the
ravine's mouth to the south.

14597.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14597.description:
A wall of grey rock rises sheer on one side of the way, dripping with
water and hung with ferns, while on the other the ground climbs gently
into the forest to the east. The bed of the ravine is stony and damp,
and a trickle threads between the stones toward its mouth to the south.
Northward the walls draw closer together. Moss grows so thick on the
rock that it would hold the print of a hand.

14598.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14598.description:
The low, rocky ridge that walls this part of the forest is cut through
here by a narrow ravine, which opens northward between walls of fern-
hung stone. A trickle of water runs out of it over a bed of pale pebbles
and sinks into the ground before it has gone ten paces. Storm-felled
trees lie to the west, and tall beeches stand east and south. The air
flowing out of the ravine is cool and smells of moss.

14599.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14599.description:
A dry bed of pale pebbles winds between the trees here, marking the
course that water from the ravine to the north must take in wetter
seasons. Birch and beech grow along its banks, and the light is clear
and bright from the open hills to the south. Storm-felled trunks lie in
a tangle to the west. Eastward, the beeches gather around a spring that
boils up through white sand.

14600.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14600.description:
Old hazel stools crowd this corner of the forest, each sprouting a dozen
straight grey poles where some woodcutter coppiced them long ago and
never came back. Bramble scrambles between them, and the light falls
bright and broken through their leaves. The eaves of the forest lie only
a few steps to the north. The way continues west into older trees, while
a beech wood begins to the east and south.

14601.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14601.description:
A row of ancient pollarded oaks stands here, each cut back at head
height long ago, so that its squat trunk swells into a great knuckled
head bristling with a crown of branches. The glade between them is
grassy and bright, sprinkled with the small yellow stars of tormentil.
The open country lies just beyond the trees to the north. Paths wander
east and west along the inside of the eaves, and the beech wood rises
tall to the south.

14602.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14602.description:
The forest thins toward its northern edge here, and daylight pours
between the trunks to wake a thicket of bramble and young birch. Beyond
the last trees to the north, the open sky shows as bright as a window. A
deer path wriggles through the brambles toward the eaves, while the
beech wood darkens again to the south and runs on east. The air is
warmer, and it carries the smell of sun-dried grass from the country
outside.

14603.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14603.description:
Grey boulders have rolled down from the stony knoll beyond the eaves and
come to rest among the trees here, half sunk in bracken and furred with
moss. Young hollies grow in their shelter. The forest's edge lies close
to the north, where a path climbs toward the knoll, and the woods
continue east, south and west.

14604.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14604.description:
Two massive oaks stand on either side of a broad gap here like the posts
of a gateway, and between them a faint, much-trodden path leads in from
the eaves to the north. Leaf litter has long since buried any trace of
the road. The forest deepens to the south, and the trees run on east and
west in long, shadowy ranks.

14605.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14605.description:
The forest is younger and lighter near its northern edge, where slender
silver birches and rowans stand among the oaks. Short moss and wood
sorrel cover the ground, and the canopy is thin enough to let in a wash
of pale green light. Bright daylight shows between the trunks to the
north where the trees give out, while the forest continues east, south
and west.

14606.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14606.description:
The trees grow big here, the first of the old giants of the forest's
interior: oaks and beeches so broad that three men could not link arms
around them. The ground is open beneath them, carpeted in moss and old
leaves. North, the eaves are near, and ways lead east, south and west
into the woods. Shafts of sunlight fall between the trunks like pillars
of gold.

14607.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14607.description:
Close to the forest's edge the trees are young and the undergrowth
dense, a scrub of hazel, elder and dog rose that grows rank in the light
from the eaves. Elderflowers smell sweet in summer, and their black
berries stain the ground in autumn. North, the way leads out to the
forest's edge, and paths run east, south and west through the scrub. The
ground is trodden into narrow, muddy runs.

14608.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14608.description:
Just within the eaves the trees here are oaks, short and broad, their
lower limbs sweeping the ground. Their shade is deep, and the floor
beneath is bare earth and leaf litter. North, a gap leads out to the
edge of the forest, and ways run east, south and west. Galls like small
brown marbles stud the oak twigs.

14609.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14609.description:
The forest is young here near its edge, a crowd of slim birch, rowan and
hazel that has sprung up where older trees once stood. Light comes
easily through their thin crowns. North, the trees open onto the eaves,
and ways lead east, south and west. Woodbine twines around many of the
slender trunks.

14610.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14610.description:
The forest begins in earnest here, just within its edge: tall oaks and
beeches crowd together, and the light dims to a green twilight. A plank
across a ditch leads north back out to the eaves, and ways run east,
south and west among the trunks. Old willow leaves, blown in from the
edge, lie yellow on the moss. The air is cool and very still.

14611.description:
Just within the ditch and bank at the forest's edge, the trees grow tall
and close, mostly oak and beech with a few dark pines among them. A gap
in the bank lets out east to the open eaves. Ways lead north toward the
corner of the forest, and south and west into the depths. Moss covers
the bank in a thick green pelt, and the ground beneath the trees is
quiet and soft.

14612.description:
A boulder as big as a cottage sits among the trees here, split clean in
two as if by an axe, and a young rowan has rooted in the crack between
the halves. Moss covers its top like a green fleece, and ferns trail
from every ledge. Beech and oak grow together around it, and the ground
slopes gently south toward a hidden gully. Brighter light shows to the
north, where the forest nears its edge.

extra_descs.boulder rock split stone rowan:
The two halves of the boulder lean apart just far enough to slip a hand
between them. The inner faces are as smooth as cut stone and veined with
white quartz, and the rowan's roots are working steadily deeper into the
crack, prising the halves further apart year by year.

14613.description:
In the heart of the beech wood the roots of four great trees meet around
a hollow, where rainwater has gathered into a dark, still pool scattered
with floating leaves. Pale fungi grow in tiers on a dead branch beside
it, like rows of little shelves. The ground is clear of brush on every
side, so you can see a long way between the grey trunks. A sunlit glade
shows through the trees to the north.

14614.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

14614.description:
The beeches here are tall and as smooth as cast pewter, bare of branches
until high overhead, where their leaves knit into a pale green roof.
Almost nothing grows beneath them, and the ground is a dry, rustling
carpet of copper leaves and split beech-mast. Someone long ago carved
letters into the bark of the nearest trunk, and the growing tree has
swollen them into broad, scarred shapes. Daylight brightens to the north
toward the edge of the forest.

extra_descs.letters carving bark beech trunk:
The letters have stretched as the beech grew, until each is a hand's
breadth tall and blurred at the edges. You can make out an R and an M
joined by a crooked heart, and beneath them a row of notches, as if
someone once counted days here.

14615.description:
A thicket of holly grows here beneath the oaks, its dark, glossy leaves
catching what little light there is and its berries glowing red. Narrow
passages wind through the prickly growth over dry, bare ground. Ways
lead north toward a scatter of boulders, east into bluebells, south, and
west among tall grey beeches.

14616.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

14616.description:
Bluebells carpet the forest floor here in a haze of violet-blue so thick
that the ground seems to float, and their cool, sweet scent fills the
air. The oaks above are tall and widely spaced, letting in a soft, even
light. Ways lead north toward two great gateway oaks, east toward a
beech arch, south toward a spring, and west to a holly thicket.

14617.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14617.description:
Two great beeches have grown together here, their trunks leaning in
until they fused high overhead into a single living arch of smooth grey
bark. Beech mast crunches underfoot, and the ground beneath the arch is
worn bare by feet that go out of their way to pass through it. The trees
thin toward the forest's edge to the north, and the woods continue east,
south and west.

extra_descs.arch beeches seam:
Where the two trunks meet, the bark has knitted into a seam like a
healed scar. Woodsmen call it the wedding arch, and say that two who
walk beneath it hand in hand will never be parted.

14618.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

14618.description:
Sunlight falls in coins and ribbons through a gap in the high beech
canopy, dappling a small glade of soft, short grass. In the middle of
the glade an old crab apple tree leans on its own elbow, its crooked
boughs heavy with small sour fruit and its bark patched with silver
lichen. The grey trunks march away north and east, and paths of trodden
leaves lead south and west beneath the boughs.

14619.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

14619.description:
The forest floor here is thick with periwinkle, its shiny dark leaves
and blue flowers spreading under the trees in a creeping carpet. The
trunks around are oak and ash, tall and straight. Ways lead north toward
the eaves, south deeper into the woods, and east and west among the
trees. A gentle breeze moves the leaves overhead, setting small shadows
dancing.

14620.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14620.description:
Two paths cross here beneath a tall wild pear tree, its trunk rough and
dark and its crown laden in autumn with small hard pears. Someone has
hung a ring of plaited straw from one low branch, faded and tattered.
Paths lead away from the tree north, south, east and west. Fallen pears
lie bruised and brown in the grass.

extra_descs.straw ring plaited:
The ring of straw is woven in the shape of a wreath, with a twist of red
wool tied through it. Country folk hang such things as gifts for
whatever dwells in the old woods, so that it will let them pass.

14621.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

14621.description:
A wide ride runs through the trees here, a long open lane once cut
through the forest for hunting and now grown up in grass and knapweed.
The trees stand back from it on either side like onlookers. Ways lead
north toward the forest edge, south along the ride, and east and west
into the woods. The grass of the ride is studded with molehills.

14622.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

14622.description:
Wood anemones carpet the ground here in spring, white stars spread
beneath the bare trees, and later the floor turns to a deep green of
their leaves. The trees are tall and smooth-barked, mostly beech, and
their roots ripple across the ground like frozen waves. Ways lead north,
south, east and west, all beneath the same high, pale grey columns. The
silence here is deep.

14623.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

14623.description:
A sunken lane runs between two banks here, so old that the banks have
become hedges of ancient hazel and holly meeting overhead. It leads east
between the stone gateposts to the forest's edge and west into the
trees, worn deep into the earth by the feet of people long gone. Gaps in
the banks lead north and south. Ferns sprout from the walls of the lane,
and its bed is soft with leaves.

14624.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

14624.description:
An old oak grows at the very lip of the gully here, its crown dead and
bare so that its topmost branches stand out above the leaves like a
stag's antlers. Holly fills the gaps between the trunks, dark and glossy
and armed with spines. Below the rim the gully drops away too steeply to
climb, its far side a shadowy bank of ferns. The beech wood lies north,
and the forest runs on east and west along the edge.

14625.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14625.description:
The beech wood stops short at the brink of a gully that cuts across the
forest floor, steep-sided and choked at the bottom with years of dead
leaves. Roots hang out over the edge like frayed ropes where the earth
has crumbled away beneath them. There is no way across, but the rim
leads on east and west beneath the beeches, and the wood rises gently to
the north. A cold breath of air rises from the gully, smelling of rot
and wet stone.

14626.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

14626.description:
Here the beech wood ends at the head of a deep gully that curves away
out of sight, its sides steep with loose earth and dangling roots. A
path follows the rim south, squeezed between the drop and a row of young
beeches. North and west, smooth grey trunks stand in orderly ranks above
a carpet of copper leaves, and the forest continues east. From somewhere
down in the gully comes the slow drip of water onto stone.

14627.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

14627.description:
Here the oaks give way to the smooth grey trunks of a beech wood, and
between the buttress roots of the largest beech rainwater has gathered
in a mossy basin as clear as glass. Copper leaves lie deep and dry
underfoot. The ground falls away to the west toward the head of a deep
gully, and ways lead north into holly, east to a spring, and south.

14628.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14628.description:
A spring wells up from beneath a mossy stone here, filling a clear
little basin before it spills away as a chattering rill. Ferns crowd
around the water, and the pebbles of its bed are bright green with weed.
The rill runs off south through the trees, and the forest is open north,
east toward an ivy-smothered oak, and west.

14629.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

14629.description:
Ivy has swallowed a great oak here so completely that the tree has
become a dark green tower, its trunk lost beneath woody stems as thick
as your arm. The ivy's pale flowers give off a heavy, sweetish smell,
and the ground beneath is littered with its dead leaves. Paths skirt the
ivy tower north and south, and the woods open east and west.

14630.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

14630.description:
Tall lime trees grow here among the beeches, and their heart-shaped
leaves drip a sticky sweetness that glazes the fallen leaves below. The
air is heavy with the scent of their pale, tasselled blossom. To the
north the light brightens toward a sunlit glade, and the forest runs on
east, south and west in long green aisles between the trunks.

14631.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

14631.description:
Old beeches stand here with their roots laid bare by the weather, so
that the trunks seem to stand on tall, twisted legs above the forest
floor. Hollows under the roots are dark and dry. Paths wind between the
stilted trunks north, south, east and west. The beech leaves above glow
copper in the afternoon light.

14632.description:
Wild strawberries carpet the ground in a sunny patch here, their tiny
red fruit hiding under trefoil leaves. The trees around are mostly
birch, and their light shade lets the sun through. Faint paths cross the
patch, running north, south, east and west. The warm air smells sweetly
of fruit and crushed leaves.

14633.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

14633.description:
Crab apple trees grow among the oaks here, gnarled and thorny, and in
autumn their small sour fruit drops to rot in the grass with a sharp,
cidery smell. The trees are hung with grey-green lichen. Ways lead
north, south, east and west, and the grass between the trees grows long
and tangled. In spring the blossom is pink and white.

14634.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

14634.description:
A great boulder of grey granite, split clean in two, sits among the
trees here, and a young rowan grows from the crack between the halves.
The stone is furred with moss on its shaded side and bare and warm on
the other. Ways pass it north and south, and paths lead east and west.
Red rowan berries lie scattered over the stone in autumn.

extra_descs.boulder split granite rowan:
The boulder has split as cleanly as if a giant's axe had struck it. The
rowan in the crack has thrust its roots deep into the gap, and country
folk say a rowan grown from stone keeps evil from the wood about it.

14635.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

14635.description:
A deer trail runs through this part of the forest, a narrow beaten line
that comes in from the hummock at the forest's edge to the east and
winds away west among the trees. Ways also lead north and south. The
trees here are a mix of oak and sweet chestnut, and spiny chestnut husks
lie split open on the ground. The light is dappled and restless as the
leaves move.

14636.description:
A narrow strip of level ground runs between the edge of the gully and
the trunks of the forest, worn into a path by the hooves of passing
deer. Holly bushes crowd the rim, their glossy leaves pricking at your
sleeves, and the drop beyond them is lost in shadow. A moss-furred log
lies beside the path like a bench left out for travellers. The way runs
north toward the beech wood and south along the gully, while the forest
opens east beneath tall oaks.

14637.description:
Tall oaks stand here in a stately rank, and from their highest branches
hang great round clumps of mistletoe, pale green against the darker
leaves. The ground beneath them is clear and level. A strip of ground
leads west toward the rim of a gully, and the woods are open north, east
toward a rill, and south.

14638.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

14638.description:
The rill from the spring runs through a stony bed here, and a line of
flat stepping stones crosses it. Alders grow along its banks, their dark
roots reaching into the water. The air is cool and smells of wet stone.
You can follow the water south or back north toward its source, and the
woods are open east and west.

14639.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

14639.description:
Bracken grows chest-high here in a rolling green sea beneath widely
spaced oaks, and its fronds brush and catch at you as you wade through.
A sour, earthy smell rises from the trampled stems. Narrow tracks pushed
through the fronds by passing beasts lead north, east, south and west,
the southern one toward a wall of grey rock.

14640.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

14640.description:
A deer path crosses here, a narrow groove of bare earth worn deep
between the ferns. Several young hornbeams beside it have been frayed to
the pale wood where stags have rubbed their antlers, and strips of bark
hang from them like torn ribbon. The path wanders off east and west,
while the open forest leads north toward the lime trees and south into
deeper shade.

14641.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

14641.description:
A clearing of short, cropped grass opens here, ringed with hawthorns. In
the middle lies a flat stone like a table, worn smooth and stained with
the black of old fires. Openings in the ring of hawthorns lead north,
south, east and west. The light here is clear and bright after the shade
of the deep woods.

14642.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

14642.description:
The ground falls away here into a shallow ravine, its sides cloaked in
hart's-tongue fern and its bottom thick with mossy boulders. A trickle
of water runs among the stones. Ways lead north and south along the
ravine floor, and east and west up its banks. The air is cool and damp,
and the light reaches the bottom only in thin green rays.

14643.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14643.description:
The ground climbs here onto a low knoll crowned with old pines, their
red upper trunks glowing wherever the sun strikes them. The air is dry
and resinous, and the needles underfoot are slippery. Ways run down off
the knoll north, south, east and west. From its top, the green roof of
the forest stretches away farther than the eye can follow.

14644.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14644.description:
Ferns grow waist-high here, a crowded sea of lady fern and buckler fern
whose fronds arch and overlap until no ground can be seen. The trees
above are old oaks hung with grey lichen. Trails push through the ferns
north, south, east and west. Every step stirs up a cool green smell, and
the fronds close silently behind you.

14645.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

east.description: To the east lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14645.description:
When the great beech at the forest's edge fell, it tore open the canopy
here, and sunlight now pours down into a long, bright gap among the
trees. Raspberry canes and foxgloves have sprung up in the light, and
the ground is warm. East, the gap runs out to the eaves and the beech's
upturned roots. Shaded woods lie north, south and west on either side of
the bright gash.

14646.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14646.description:
A long face of grey rock juts up through the forest here, taller than
three men and running away out of sight among the trees. Water seeps
down its stained surface, feeding cushions of moss and the polypody
ferns that sprout from every crack. There is no way over it, but the
forest stays open north toward a sea of bracken, east toward an old
sawpit, and south along the foot of the rock.

14647.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14647.description:
An old sawpit lies open in the forest floor here, a long trench where
woodcutters once stood to rip logs into planks, its sides slumped and
furred with moss. A rotten trestle still straddles one end, and the
sawdust heap beside it has long since rotted into a mound of dark earth
sprouting nettles. The forest is open north toward a deer path, east and
west, and south among oaks and ashes.

14648.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14648.description:
Cobwebs drape the undergrowth here in great grey sheets, heavy with dew
and strung between the bushes and low branches, some of them far too
large for any ordinary spinner. The trees are old and dead-limbed, their
bark peeling. Ways lead north, south, east and west, though the webs
must be pushed aside. The forest is very quiet here, and the air feels
close.

14649.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14649.description:
A huge yew stands alone here, its dark crown spreading wide and its
trunk split into a dozen fluted stems. Nothing grows beneath it, and the
ground is bare, dry and red with fallen needles. Ways lead north, south,
east and west from beneath its shade. The yew is old beyond telling, and
the silence beneath it feels deliberate.

14650.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14650.description:
A tiny clearing here holds a forest pool no bigger than a cartwheel, so
still and dark that it mirrors the leaves above it perfectly. Mossy
stones ring its edge, and its water is clear and very cold. Ways lead
north, south, east and west among the surrounding birches and oaks.
Fallen leaves float motionless on the surface.

14651.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14651.description:
The ground is laced with roots here, great serpentine roots of beech
that coil over and under one another and across the rocks, so that every
step must be chosen with care. Hollows between them hold black pools of
rainwater. Ways lead north and south between the trunks, and east and
west over the roots. The beeches above are vast, their smooth bark
carved with initials long since stretched out of shape.

14652.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

14652.description:
Birches march in from the forest's edge and grow here among the darker
oaks, their white trunks gleaming in the gloom like candles. Bracket
fungi, hard and grey, jut in tiers from the dead ones. The eaves lie
east, bright beyond the white trunks, while the forest continues north,
south and west. Fallen birch bark curls in pale scrolls upon the ground.

14653.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

14653.description:
Boulders fallen from a grey outcrop lie scattered among the trees here,
each blanketed in moss so thick that they look like great green beasts
asleep in the leaf litter. The outcrop itself rises sheer beside you,
closing off the way on one side, its face streaked dark with seeping
water. The forest is open north along the foot of the rock, east among
the oaks and south into older growth.

14654.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

14654.description:
Oak and ash grow side by side here, the oaks broad and twisted, the
ashes straight and grey and hung with bunches of winged keys. A dead ash
still stands among them, bleached white and riddled from root to crown
with neat round holes. Somewhere above, wood creaks against wood
whenever the wind stirs. The forest stretches away north, east and west,
and grows noticeably darker to the south.

14655.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

14655.description:
The forest grows dark here, the canopy thick and the trunks of the trees
close together. Old pines and yews mix with the oaks, and the ground is
soft with needles. Ways lead north, south, east and west, the southern
way sloping downhill into deeper shadow. Little light reaches the floor,
and the air is cold and smells of resin.

14656.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14656.description:
A wall of tangled bramble and fallen trees closes the forest off here,
piled so high and thick that no way leads on through it. The ground is
broken and rough with deadfall. Ways lead north, and east and west along
the barrier. Briars hang thickly from the dead branches, and the smell
of decay is strong.

14657.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

14657.description:
Bluebells flood the ground here in spring, a hazy blue sea beneath the
new green of the beeches, and their sweet scent fills the woods. Later
in the year the floor is a mass of strappy leaves and rattling seed
heads. Ways lead north, south, east and west through the beech wood. The
trunks rise grey and smooth, like the pillars of a hall without walls.

14658.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

14658.description:
Below the mossy dell the ground levels into a flat of wood sorrel, its
clover-like leaves folding shut in shade and opening wherever a sunbeam
strikes. The trees are slim oaks, close-set and straight. East, the dell
dips down toward its welling spring, and ways lead north, south and
west. The floor is so soft with leaf mould that footsteps make no sound
at all.

14659.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

14659.description:
A mossy dell dips here among the oaks, and at its bottom water wells up
through a bed of green and gold moss to feed the stream that runs east
to the spring at the forest's edge. Every stone and root in the dell is
cushioned in moss, deep and soft as a feather bed. Ways climb out of the
dell north, south and west. The light is green, and the air is hushed
and damp.

14660.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

14660.description:
A stand of tall, straight ashes rises here, their pale trunks bare of
branches for forty feet, like the masts of ships riding at anchor. The
light between them is clear and cool, and the floor is carpeted with
dog's mercury and the dry curls of last year's leaves. Wide aisles run
north and east between the trunks, while the undergrowth of the older
woods thickens south and west.

14661.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

14661.description:
A great hollow oak stands here, its trunk split open on one side to show
a dark chamber within, big enough for two people to stand in. The inside
is dry and smells of old wood dust. Ways lead north, south and west
around it, and east toward the ring of seven oaks. Above the split the
tree still lives, its crown broad and green.

14662.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

14662.description:
A ring of seven old oaks stands here around a bare patch of earth where
nothing grows, as if the trees had drawn back to leave room for
something. The ground within the ring is packed hard and faintly warm.
Gaps between the trunks lead north, south and west, and east toward the
old fire scars. Mistletoe hangs in pale green balls high in the oak
crowns.

extra_descs.ring oaks bare earth:
The seven oaks stand almost evenly spaced, and the bare earth between
them is marked with faint rings, as if many small feet had danced there
on summer nights.

14663.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

14663.description:
Fire passed through this part of the forest long ago, and its mark
remains in the blackened, hollowed trunks of the oldest trees, still
living around their charred hearts. Young birch and rowan have filled
the gaps the flames made. East, the dead pines stand grey at the eaves,
and ways lead north, south and west among the scarred survivors.
Charcoal still shows in the soil wherever the moss has been scraped
away.

14664.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

14664.description:
A little brook comes chuckling through the trees here, clear over brown
pebbles, and wanders on between banks thick with marsh marigold.
Stepping stones cross it, slick with green weed. Ways lead north and
south along its banks and east and west across it. The air is fresh and
full of the sound of running water.

14665.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

14665.description:
Bracken spills in from the forest's edge and covers the floor here in a
rustling green tide, so tall that only the trunks of the oaks rise above
it. A narrow track parts the fronds, running north and south, and other
gaps lead east and west. Beneath the bracken the ground is hidden, and
roots and holes catch at careless feet. The smell of warm, dry fern
hangs over everything.

14666.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14666.description:
The brook pools here behind a dam of fallen branches and silt, forming a
still, dark pond that mirrors the canopy. Water lilies spread across its
surface, and the banks are soft and trampled with hoof prints where
beasts come down to drink. A path skirts the pond north and south, and
ways lead east and west among the trees. The smell of still water and
waterweed hangs in the air.

14667.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

14667.description:
Coppiced hazels stand in a ragged grove here, each stool sending up a
dozen tall straight poles from a single gnarled base, though no one has
cut them in many years. Old axe marks still show on the stools. East, an
overgrown cart track leads out past a ruined hut toward the forest's
edge. The woods run on north and south, and west the hazels give way to
taller trees.

14668.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14668.description:
Below the pond the brook spills over a lip of rock in a little waterfall
no higher than a man's knee, and the spray keeps the stones around it
green and shining. Ferns crowd every ledge. Ways lead north to the pond,
south downstream, and east and west through the woods. The constant
splash of falling water fills this part of the forest.

14669.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14669.description:
The trees here are old and broad, and many bear long scars where stags
have rubbed the velvet from their antlers, the bark shredded and hanging
in strips. Deer trails converge from every side, crossing the leaf
litter in narrow beaten lines. East lies the sheltered grassy bay at the
forest's edge, and the woods continue north, south and west. A musky
scent hangs in the still air.

14670.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14670.description:
A wide, sunny glade opens here among the beeches, its floor a lawn of
fine grass kept short by grazing deer. A path leads east through the
trees toward the standing stone at the forest's edge, and others go
north, south and west into the woods. Beech mast lies thick along the
margins of the glade. The open grass is warm and bright, and smells of
crushed clover.

14671.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14671.description:
Holly grows thick beneath the taller trees here, a dark understorey of
glossy leaves that makes the forest seem dim even at noon. Narrow paths
wind through it east to the forest's edge and north, south and west
deeper among the trunks. The holly leaves rattle stiffly when anything
brushes past them. Beneath the bushes lies a dry, prickly floor where
little else will grow.

14672.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14672.description:
The ground is wet and spongy here, with water seeping out from under the
moss and gathering in dark pools between the tree roots. Alders grow
along the wettest stretches, their roots arching out of the mud like the
ribs of a basket. Drier ground lies north and south, a squelching way
leads east toward the forest edge, and a rise in the land offers a
firmer path west. The air is heavy with the smell of rot and growing
things.

14673.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

east.description: To the east lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.
