14673.description:
Broad, low-branched oaks fill this part of the forest, their limbs
reaching sideways more than up, so that the canopy is wide and the light
beneath it soft and green. Acorn cups and oak apples litter the ground
among patches of bluebells. The eaves and their foxgloves lie east, and
the oak wood continues north, south and west. Every low twig has been
browsed away to the height of a man's chin.

14674.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14674.description:
The path keeps close to the lip of a steep gully here, with only a
fringe of ivy between your boots and the drop. A tall ash leans out over
the gap at a perilous angle, half its roots torn bare and clutching at
empty air. Mist lies thick in the bottom of the gully, hiding the floor
of rotting leaves far below. The rim path runs north and south, and the
trees stand a little more open to the east.

14675.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14675.description:
A single huge yew stands here in a small open space, its fluted red
trunk splitting into a dozen limbs and its dark foliage spreading low
and wide. Nothing grows beneath it. On one side a great heap of
deadfall, woven through with bramble and dog rose, closes the way. Paths
lead north among tall oaks, south, and west toward the lip of a gully.

14676.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14676.description:
An immense oak stands here, so old that its heart has rotted clean away,
leaving a hollow trunk wide enough for three people to shelter inside.
The deep gully that has run beside the path peters out here into a
shallow dell of ferns and dead leaves. North, a narrow path climbs along
the gully's rim, while the forest runs on east and south beneath a
canopy so thick that the light comes down green. Acorn cups crunch
underfoot, and the air smells of damp bark.

14677.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14677.description:
The canopy here is a dense weave of beech and hornbeam, and the light
that comes through is so green that your own hands look strange in it. A
slope of loose earth and stones closes the way on one side, fringed
along its top with bare roots. Paths lead north toward a great yew,
south toward a root-tangled bank, and west to a hollow oak.

14678.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14678.description:
The forest gives way here to soft, sodden ground at the head of a wide
reedy fen, where a fern-filled dell drains away into the reeds. An old
causeway of split logs leads west across the wet ground to a grassy ride
among the elms. The forest is open north toward a hollow oak and east
toward a root-tangled bank, and the air smells of wet moss.

14679.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14679.description:
A steep bank closes off one side of this place, its face a great knotted
lattice of bare roots where the earth has washed away. Small ferns and
toadstools grow in the pockets between them. Paths lead north under a
dense green canopy, east toward the sound of running water, and west
toward the soft ground at the head of a fen.

14680.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14680.description:
The rill slips beneath a great arch of beech roots here and gurgles out
the other side, cutting a deep little channel through the soft earth.
Kingcups grow along its wet margins, bright yellow against the dark mud,
and the ground is springy on both banks. The water runs on south, and
the forest opens north, east, and west toward a bank of tangled roots.

14681.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14681.description:
The oaks here are truly ancient, their trunks as wide as a cottage and
their lowest limbs as thick as lesser trees. Ferns and small saplings
grow in the crooks of the branches high overhead, a garden in the air.
Beneath them the deep shade keeps the floor nearly bare. The rooted
shoulders of the old giants part to let you pass north, east, south and
west.

14682.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14682.description:
The trunk of a great oak here is scored with deep, raking gouges, four
parallel furrows torn through the bark higher than a tall man could
reach. Below them a rotten log has been ripped apart and flung about,
its punky wood strewn among tufts of coarse brown fur. Whatever did this
was strong beyond reason. Paths lead away north and south, and the trees
open a little east and west.

extra_descs.gouges furrows claw marks:
Each furrow is as wide as your finger and bitten deep into the living
wood, and sap has wept from them and dried into beads of amber. Caught
in the splinters at the top are a few stiff brown feathers, a strange
thing to find on a bear's mark.

14683.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14683.description:
Here the ground falls away on one side into a wide, reedy fen, and the
rill runs along its edge, gathering speed. Beyond the reeds lie pools of
black water and tussocks of sedge where no one could walk dry-shod. A
path follows the edge of the fen north and south beside the rill, and
the woods open east among mossy hummocks.

14684.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14684.description:
Moss covers everything here in a deep, spongy blanket, smothering fallen
logs and stones alike until the forest floor is a landscape of soft
green hummocks. Your feet sink in to the ankle with every step, and
water squeezes up around your boots. The thick quiet is broken only by
the drip of moisture from the leaves. Ways wind north, east, south and
west between the mossy mounds.

14685.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14685.description:
The ground sinks into a shallow hollow here where a thin white mist
lingers long after it has lifted elsewhere. Dew beads every fern frond
and spangles the small webs strung between them, and the air is cold and
damp against your face. The trunks rising out of the mist look grey and
ghostly, and the way climbs gently out of the hollow to the north, east,
south and west.

14686.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14686.description:
A flat circle of blackened earth lies here where charcoal burners once
built their smouldering mounds, so long ago that no one could say when.
Little grows on the scorched ground save a fuzz of moss, and bracket
fungi crowd the stumps the burners left around its rim. The forest has
crept back close on every side, with ways leading north among pale ashes
and east, south and west into older growth.

14687.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14687.description:
The trees here are hornbeam and field maple, small and twisted, crowding
together beneath a few towering oaks. The maples turn the colour of
flame in autumn, and their fallen leaves lie in bright drifts. Ways lead
north and south, east toward the brook's still pond, and west into the
deeper forest. The ground is uneven, humped with mossy hummocks under
the leaves.

14688.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14688.description:
The rill drops over a ledge of dark rock here in a small, bright
waterfall and gathers in a clear pool before running on. Ferns frame the
fall, and the stones of the pool's bed are furred with green. Beyond the
pool the reeds of the fen close off the way on one side. Paths lead
north and south along the water, and east into the trees.

14689.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14689.description:
An old beech has grown over a great boulder here, clasping it in a fist
of grey roots that spill down its sides and dig into the earth all
around. Moss fills every crevice between root and stone, and the beech's
crown spreads wide above. The woods are open north, east and south, and
west toward the sound of falling water.

14690.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14690.description:
The roots of the beeches here have broken the surface and knotted across
the ground in a great grey net, so that every step means stepping over
or between them. Pockets of black water collect in the hollows of the
tangle, each holding a small dark reflection of the canopy. Picking your
way with care, you can go north, east, south or west.

14691.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14691.description:
A dark knot of firs grows here amid the broadleaves, and their resinous
scent is sharp in the still air. The ground beneath them is a springy
mat of brown needles where nothing else will grow, and their low dead
branches are hung with grey-green tatters of lichen. Beyond the firs the
oaks and beeches resume, the way open north and south as well as east
and west.

14692.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14692.description:
A pair of standing timbers, the posts of some forgotten gateway, rise
here among the trees, black with age and carved with interlacing knots
now soft with moss. No fence or wall runs from them, for the forest has
swallowed whatever they once guarded. Ways lead north and south between
the posts, east toward the little waterfall and west into older woods.
The ground is thick with dog violets.

14693.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14693.description:
Here the rill loses itself among the reeds of the fen, spreading into
dark pools where tufts of cotton grass nod. Alder and willow lean over
the boggy margin, and the ground quakes underfoot near the water. A firm
path leads north upstream along the rill and south beside the fen, and
the woods are open east toward a glade.

14694.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14694.description:
A small glade opens here around a broad, flat-topped stone like a table
set out in the forest. Wood anemones and sorrel grow thickly in the
light that falls into the glade, and the stone itself is warm to the
touch. Ways lead out of the glade north, east, south and west into the
shadowed trees.

14695.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14695.description:
The old growth is so dense overhead that almost nothing grows beneath
it, and the massive trunks stand alone on a bare floor of brown leaves.
Sound dies quickly in the hush, so that your own footsteps seem loud and
rude. Moss climbs every trunk on the same side, a soft green that almost
glows in the gloom. The great trees go on and on, north, south, east and
west.

14696.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

14696.description:
High in the trunk of a great split oak, a fissure oozes dark wild honey
that has run down the bark in long, glistening streaks. The sweet smell
hangs heavy in the air, mingled with the scent of honeysuckle twining
through the lower branches. The ground beneath is sticky with old drips.
The woods continue east and west, and the oak's twin trunks frame the
ways north and south.

14697.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14697.description:
A great oak stands here whose trunk is swollen with burrs, rounded knobs
of twisted grain that bulge from the bark like the faces of old men,
frowning, grinning or asleep. The forest around it is dark and old, and
the air is very still. Ways lead north toward a sunny glade, east and
west, and south into a tangle of fallen trunks.

extra_descs.burrs faces knobs:
Look long enough and the burrs become a crowd: a bearded king, a
sleeping child, a man with his mouth open in a shout. Someone has
pressed a copper coin into the eye of the largest, and the bark is
slowly swallowing it.

14698.description:
Several animal trails converge on a patch of churned black mud here,
pitted with the cloven prints of deer and the heavier, rounder marks of
boar. The canopy is so high and unbroken that the light is a deep green
dusk even at noon. Trails leave the mud north, east and west, and a
longer one slopes away south through the trees.

14699.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

14699.description:
Young saplings and brambles have rushed up into the space left by a
fallen oak, weaving a thicket so dense that it walls off one side of the
clearing. Blackberries ripen among the thorns, and the trampled grass of
the open part is pocked with hoofprints. A way leads north into taller
trees, while narrow gaps let you squeeze off east or west.

14700.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

14700.description:
Just inside the eaves the trees are wind-shaped and stunted, their
trunks twisted and their branches all leaning the same way, as though
bowing to some old command. Heather gives way here to moss and the first
beds of wood sorrel. East, light shows bright where the trees end, and
the edge path lies south through a gap. The deeper woods rise north and
west, taller with every step.

14701.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

14701.description:
The trail that began at the end of the cart track winds through a stand
of young hornbeams here, their grey trunks fluted like temple columns.
The ground is firm and dry, littered with crisp brown leaves that cling
to the twigs through the winter. Ways lead north and south along the
inside of the forest edge, and the trail runs on west into the deeper
woods. East, the trees thin toward the open eaves.

14702.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

14702.description:
Old yews grow in a dark cluster here, their reddish trunks split and
hollowed with age and their dense needles shutting out most of the
light. Nothing grows beneath them but a thin carpet of needles and
fallen red berries. East, brightness and the scent of gorse drift in
from the forest edge. Ways lead north and south between the yews, and a
darker passage runs west.

14703.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14703.description:
A sycamore of great size spreads its limbs over a small clearing here,
and its winged seeds lie in drifts about its roots. Light falls in soft
green pools through the gaps in its canopy. The open eaves show east,
and the woods continue north, south and west. The ground is rich and
black, crowded with young sycamore seedlings fighting for the light.

14704.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14704.description:
Ash and hazel share this stretch of woodland, the tall ash letting down
a flickering light and the hazel crowding beneath in a tangle of springy
stems. Hazelnut shells, split and empty, crunch underfoot. The eaves lie
east, bright through the trees, and the forest runs on north, south and
west. A neat line of holes has been drilled up one of the ash trunks by
some patient beak.

14705.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14705.description:
The stream that runs out through the gully at the forest's edge passes
through here in a deep, fern-hung cleft, gurgling unseen beneath the
fronds. A mossy log crosses it, the only dry way over. East, the cleft
opens toward the eaves, and the woods continue north and south along the
bank and west upstream. The air is cool and damp, and smells of wet
stone and liverwort.

14707.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14707.description:
The brook vanishes here into a crack among the tree roots, swallowed by
the earth with a hollow gurgle through a gap far too narrow for anyone
to follow. Moss-covered rocks ring the crack, and cold air breathes out
of it. Ways lead north back toward the waterfall, and south, east and
west through the forest. Lichen grows thick on every trunk here, grey-
green and shaggy.

14708.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

14708.description:
A dense thicket of young beech saplings fills this stretch, each stem
straining upward toward a gap in the canopy left by some fallen giant.
Their dry brown leaves hang on through the winter and whisper
constantly. Narrow ways lead north and south through the thicket, and
east and west where the saplings thin. The remains of the old tree lie
half hidden, a long mound of moss and fungus.

14709.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14709.description:
Fungi of every kind sprout from the deadwood here: shelves of orange,
clusters of grey bells, and white puffballs the size of a man's head. A
heavy, earthy smell rises from the rotting logs. Ways lead north, south
and west, and east toward wetter ground near the forest's edge. The
light is dim, the canopy closed overhead.

14710.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14710.description:
Honeysuckle and bramble riot over the ground here, tangled together in
great mounds between the trunks. The scent of the honeysuckle is heavy
and sweet on warm evenings. Narrow ways have been forced through the
tangle north, south, east and west. Torn tufts of fur hang in the
brambles where beasts have pushed through.

14711.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14711.description:
A clearing opens here where a woodcutter once worked, and a circle of
flat stumps, grey and soft with age, stands among the young growth. One
great stump in the middle served as a chopping block, and its top is
scored with a thousand cuts. Ways lead north, south, east and west from
the clearing. Willowherb grows tall and pink in the sun.

14712.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14712.description:
Moss has covered everything here, the ground, the rocks, the fallen logs
and the trunks of the trees up to the height of a man, so that the whole
wood is green and soft. The light is dim and as green as deep water.
Ways lead north, south, east and west through the moss-hung trees. Every
sound is swallowed, and the forest feels as hushed as a held breath.

14713.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14713.description:
The forest thins toward its lower edge here, where the trees give way to
bracken and the light grows stronger. A path leads south out of the
trees to the eaves, and ways run north, east and west through the last
of the woods. The trees are crooked rowans and old thorns, gnarled by
the wind. A heap of stones, perhaps an old field clearance, lies
overgrown among the bracken.

14714.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

14714.description:
Mist collects among the trees here, rising from the damp ground and
hanging in pale drifts between the trunks, so that the forest fades into
grey only a few paces away. Ways lead north and west into the mist, east
through the trees, and south out to the eaves where the light is
brighter. Beads of moisture cling to every twig and leaf. The ground is
soft and wet.

14715.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

14715.description:
The mist lies thick in this hollow of the forest, and the trees loom out
of it like grey ghosts, their branches dripping steadily. Roots break
the surface of the ground in twisted loops, ready to trip the unwary.
Ways lead north, south, east and west, though in the mist each looks
much like the others. The only sound is the patter of drops on dead
leaves.

14716.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

14716.description:
The trees here are ancient oaks, gnarled and hollow, their limbs heavy
with grey beards of lichen that hang motionless in the misty air. One
has a hollow at its foot large enough for a man to crawl into, though it
holds nothing but leaves. Ways lead north, south, east and west among
them. The air is cold and smells of wet bark.

14717.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

14717.description:
A slow stream creeps through this part of the forest, so sluggish and
choked with weed that it barely seems to move. Mist rises from its
surface, and its banks are deep black mud. A fallen trunk bridges it,
leading north and south, and ways run east and west along its banks.
Marsh plants with broad, heavy leaves crowd the water's edge.

14718.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

14718.description:
Roots tangle the ground so thickly here that it is like walking on a
woven mat, with gaps between them that drop into dark holes. The trees
above are huge beeches. Ways lead north and south across the roots, and
east toward the old forest road. Beyond the far trunks a thicket of
blackthorn rises like a solid wall, too dense to pass.

14719.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

14719.description:
The blackthorn thicket hems this pocket of forest closely, its black
stems and long thorns forming a barrier that nothing could pass. Within
its curve the ground is mossy and sheltered, and mist pools there like
water in a bowl. Ways lead north and south along the thicket, and east
toward the pines. Sloes hang blue-black on the thorns in autumn.

14720.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14720.description:
Cherry trees have spread inward from the forest margin here, mingling
with oak and lime, and their red-banded trunks stand out among the grey.
Lime flowers sweeten the air in summer, and the ground beneath is
scattered with cherry stones and fallen leaves. The edge of the forest
lies east, and ways lead north, south and west through the mixed
woodland. Shafts of sunlight slant down through the canopy.

14721.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14721.description:
The tumbled boundary wall at the forest's edge has a twin here, a second
and older line of stones running deeper in among the trees, half sunk in
moss and leaf mould. Ivy-covered gaps in it lead east toward the open
eaves, north and south along its length, and west into shadow. Ferns
crowd its foot, and the stones are cold and wet to the touch. No one
remembers who raised either wall, or why.

14722.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

14722.description:
The forest opens a little here where several trails cross, worn by deer
and boar into narrow, muddy ruts. A huge wallow of churned mud lies in a
low spot, rimmed with coarse bristles where boar have rolled. Trails run
off from the crossing north, south, east and west. The smell of mud and
beast is strong.

14723.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14723.description:
A tall dead oak stands here stripped of its bark, its white limbs raised
like bones against the green canopy. Its trunk is riddled with holes,
some old and some fresh. Ways lead north and south past it, and east
toward the beech thicket. Below it the ground is littered with fallen
branches, grey and brittle.

14724.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14724.description:
A low ridge of mossy rocks runs through the forest here, broken into
stepping blocks and small ledges where ferns grow. The trees cling to it
with roots that wrap the stones like fingers. Ways lead north and south
along the ridge, and east down toward the fungus-covered deadwood. A
cleft between two rocks is packed with dry leaves blown in by the wind.

14725.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14725.description:
Old limes grow here, each trunk ringed by a thicket of its own suckers,
so that every tree stands in a little grove of its own. In summer the
air is heavy with the honey scent of their flowers. Ways lead north and
south between the lime groves, and east toward two trees grown into one.
The ground is soft with old lime leaves.

14726.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14726.description:
Whitebeams grow here among the oaks, and whenever the wind turns their
leaves the whole wood flashes silver with their pale undersides. A dense
thicket of holly closes the way on one side, and the ground is dry and
stony. Paths lead east, south into a fern-lined dell, and west toward an
old quarry.

14727.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14727.description:
A sheltered dell lies here, its sides lined with ferns and its floor
holding a still, dark pool fed by a trickle from the rocks. The water is
so clear that the drowned leaves on its bottom seem close enough to
touch. Ways lead north among whitebeams, and east, south and west up out
of the dell.

14728.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14728.description:
Old oaks hung with long grey beards of lichen stand here in a damp,
misty stillness, their branches dripping. The lichen stirs gently though
there is hardly any wind, and the mist muffles every sound. Wood sorrel
covers the ground between the trunks. Ways lead north, east and west,
and south toward brighter light at the forest's edge.

14729.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14729.description:
The trees grow farther apart here as the forest nears its southern edge,
and brighter light filters through the thinning canopy. Bramble and
young holly fill the gaps between the trunks, and the air smells of warm
grass drifting in from the open country. The eaves lie just to the
south, and the forest continues north, east and west.

14730.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14730.description:
Hawthorn and blackthorn crowd together here beneath the oaks, white with
blossom and shaken by the wind that comes in from the open land nearby.
The ground is grassy and the light is bright. An old wall shows through
the trees to the south where the forest ends, and the woods continue
north, east and west.

14731.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14731.description:
Daylight floods in from the south, where the forest ends a few steps
away and open hillside begins. Bracken and gorse have crept in under the
outer trees, and the wind that reaches this far smells of heather and
sun-warmed stone. A rotting line of fence posts marks where someone once
tried to keep the hill's sheep from straying into the woods. Tall grey
beeches rise to the north, and the forest runs on east and west.

14732.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14732.description:
Beeches and hornbeams share this part of the forest, their grey trunks
twisted like knotted muscle. Between the spreading roots of the largest
beech, something has scraped out a deep den, ringed with heaps of broken
branches, torn moss and shed feathers as long as your forearm. The earth
around it is churned and smells rank. The forest stretches north and
east, a holly thicket lies to the west, and the trees thin southward
toward the eaves.

14733.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14733.description:
The ruin of an old lime kiln stands here, a squat round tower of
mortared stone with a blackened arch at its foot, half swallowed by ivy
and elder. The ground around it is pale and chalky, and nettles grow
rank in the old ash pit. Ways lead north, east toward the misty oaks,
south and west.

14734.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14734.description:
Wild cherry trees grow tall and slender among the oaks here, their
glossy bark banded and peeling in coppery strips. Small dark cherries
hang in the high branches, and their stones crunch underfoot. Ways lead
north toward an old quarry, east, south toward a ruined kiln, and west
among sweet chestnuts.

14735.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14735.description:
A small quarry has been cut into a rise of pale stone here, its face
sheer and streaked with rain, closing off the way on one side. Squared
blocks that were never carted away lie half buried in brambles at its
foot, and saplings sprout from the ledges above. Paths lead east and
west past the quarry floor, and south into the trees.

14736.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14736.description:
The ground rises here into a low sandy knoll where a stand of tall pines
has taken root among the broadleaves. Their red trunks glow warmly where
the light strikes them, and the sand underfoot is soft and dry, strewn
with needles. A long trail climbs away north, and paths lead down off
the knoll east, south and west.

14737.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14737.description:
A grassy track, the ghost of an old forest road, runs through here,
wider than any deer trail and lined with low banks on either side. Its
surface is sunken and green, and saplings grow from its middle. Ways
lead north and south through the trees, east along the old road toward
the eaves, and west down into a misty hollow. A mossy milestone leans
beside the track.

extra_descs.milestone stone mossy:
Scraping back the moss shows a carved number, a worn letter that might
be a K, and an arrow pointing along the old road toward the forest's
edge.

14738.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

14738.description:
Old pines grow here among the broadleaves, their trunks straight and
russet, and a thick bed of needles muffles the ground. Resin seeps in
amber beads from old wounds in their bark, and its sharp scent fills the
air. Ways lead north and south among the pines, east toward the stream
cleft, and west into mist that gathers in a hollow. Pine cones lie
scattered everywhere.

14739.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14739.description:
A steep bank rises among the trees here, too sheer and crumbling to
climb, its face a tangle of bare roots and yellow sand. Ways lead north
and south along its foot, and east toward the cherry trees near the
eaves. Burrows riddle the sand of the bank in neat round holes. Pebbles
trickle down its face whenever the wind stirs the trees above.

14740.description:
The forest floor is thickly carpeted here with dog's mercury and wild
garlic, and the sharp smell of the garlic rises with every step. White
starry flowers cover the ground in spring. Ways lead north and south,
east toward the old wall in the woods, and west into a darker part of
the forest. The trees are tall ashes, letting through a pale, even
light.

14741.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14741.description:
Two great trees, an oak and a beech, have grown so close together that
their trunks have fused at the base into a single massive column,
parting again higher up. Travellers call such pairs lovers' trees, and
many initials have been cut into the joined bark. Ways lead north,
south, east and west around them. Ivy climbs both trunks into the
canopy.

14742.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14742.description:
A strange stillness lies over this part of the forest, where the trees
are tall and straight and the ground beneath them is bare of all but
moss. The blackthorn wall continues beyond the trunks, unbroken. Ways
lead north and south, and east toward the beds of wild garlic. A single
great white stone, smooth as an egg, sits half buried in the moss.

extra_descs.white stone egg:
The stone is milk-white and cool even in summer, its surface so smooth
it feels polished. Nothing grows on it, not even lichen.

14743.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14743.description:
The forest floor begins a long, gentle descent here, and ground ivy and
violets grow in the leaf litter. A deer trail runs downhill to the
south, winding for some distance through ranks of old oaks and beeches.
Back to the north the trees are thicker and darker, and a path leads
west beside a tangle of fallen trunks.

14744.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14744.description:
Fallen trunks lie piled here in a great tangle, as though a whole stand
of trees came down together in some long-past storm. Ivy and moss
smother the heap, and the gaps beneath it are black and deep. There is
no going through it, but a path leads north toward an oak knobbed with
burrs, and another runs east around the edge of the tangle.

14745.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14745.description:
A long trail runs through a thicket of young beeches here, whose dead
copper leaves cling to their twigs and whisper at every breath of air.
To the west the ground drops into the stony bed of a ravine. The trail
runs north for some way toward a ford, and paths lead east toward a
sandy knoll and south among sweet chestnuts.

14746.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14746.description:
The waters of the fen gather here into a brown brook that slides out
from among the reeds and runs across the forest floor in a broad,
shallow ford. Stepping stones cross it to the west, where an old grassy
ride runs among the elms. Paths lead north along the edge of the fen,
east toward an oak knobbed with burrs, and south along a long trail.

14747.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14747.description:
Sweet chestnut trees grow here, their massive trunks twisted with deep
spiralling furrows as if wrung by giant hands. Their spiny husks litter
the ground and prickle underfoot, and long toothed leaves rattle
overhead. The forest is open north, east and south, and to the west the
ground falls steeply into a rocky ravine.

14748.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14748.description:
A lightning-struck oak stands at the centre of a small glade here, its
trunk split from crown to root and scorched black along the wound,
though green leaves still sprout from one half. Harebells and bracken
crowd the sunny ground around it. The way west leads toward the mouth of
a rocky ravine, while the forest runs north, east and south beneath tall
beeches. A faint smell of old burning still clings to the riven wood.

14749.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14749.description:
A dense thicket of holly closes in here, dark and glossy and impossible
to push through, so that the way must bend around it. The ground beneath
the hollies is bare and brown, littered with dead spiny leaves that
crackle and prick. Tall beeches stand to the east and west of the
thicket, and the trees thin to the south toward the edge of the forest.
The air is cool and very still.

14750.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14750.description:
A spring rises among the beeches here, bubbling up through a ring of
white sand in a basin no bigger than a cartwheel, so clear that every
grain can be seen dancing. Watercress and brooklime choke the little
runnel that drains it away into the leaves. The light is brighter to the
south, where the forest ends. Paths lead north toward a sunny glade, and
east and west through the trees.

14751.name: The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14751.description:
Grey stones break through the thin soil here, and the beeches that grow
among them have spread their roots wide across the rock in search of
earth. One flat stone has a round hollow worn into its top, brimming
with rainwater. Light comes in from the south, where the trees end, and
a holly thicket darkens the way to the north. The going is easier east
and west along the slope.

14800.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

east.description: To the east lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14800.description:
A single great pine stands at the corner of the forest here, far taller
than the trees around it, its crown flattened by the wind into a dark
green table. It can be seen for miles across the heath and the open
country beyond, and travellers have long used it as a landmark. From its
foot the eaves run east and south, one line facing the open grasslands,
the other the distant sea.

extra_descs.pine tree great lone:
The pine's trunk is as thick as a tower and its bark is plated like
armour in rust-red scales. Someone has cut a deep notch into it at
shoulder height, and around its foot a ring of white pebbles has been
pressed into the earth by passing travellers.

14801.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

east.description: To the east lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14801.description:
A sandy track runs along the outside of the eaves here, rutted by long-
gone carts and scraped by rabbits. Grass gives way to heather and gorse
toward the forest's corner to the west, and the wind carries a faint
tang of salt. The trees stand close to the south, a mix of birch and oak
bent by the weather. The track leads on east along the edge of the
forest.

14802.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

east.description: To the east lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14802.description:
The ground swells into a gorse-covered rise just outside the forest, the
spiny bushes bright with yellow flowers that smell warm and sweet in the
sun. From the top you can see far out over rolling country, where the
land opens into wide grasslands under an enormous sky. The forest stands
at your back to the south, dark and tall. The eaves run east and west,
edged by an old earthen bank.

14803.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

east.description: To the east lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14803.description:
An old earthen bank runs along the edge of the forest here, topped with
a row of gnarled hawthorns, as if someone once meant to keep the trees
from spreading. On one side the wood stands dark and close; on the
other, rough pasture rolls away under a wide sky toward distant
grasslands. The bank leads east and west along the eaves, and a gap in
it lets a path slip south into the bracken beneath the trees. The wind
combs the long grass into silver waves.

14804.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

east.description: To the east lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

down.description: To the down lies The Tunnel Of Sticks.

14804.description:
At the forest's edge a dark hole opens among the roots of an old oak,
its mouth braced with splintered timbers and woven sticks, and a crude
passage leads down into the earth. Cold, damp air breathes up out of it,
for this is the way down into the Tunnel of Sticks. A hawthorn-topped
bank runs off west along the eaves, the edge of the trees continues
east, and an old ride leads south into the forest.

extra_descs.hole mouth sticks timbers:
The sticks are woven together like the wall of a basket, and some still
bear green leaves, as though the weaving is never finished. Fresh
scratches score the timbers at the mouth, made by claws or by fingers.

14805.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

east.description: To the east lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14805.description:
Brushwood and dead sticks lie heaped along the forest's edge here in
long, untidy windrows, as though someone had swept the floor of the
woods and left the sweepings. Beyond the last trees open grassland rolls
away under the sky. The eaves run east and west, and old hazels crowd
the forest's edge to the south.

14806.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

east.description: To the east lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14806.description:
A scatter of old stumps marks where woodcutters once took timber from
the forest's edge, and rosebay and raspberry canes have sprung up
thickly among them. The sky is wide overhead, and the wind comes in off
the open land carrying the smell of grass. The eaves run east and west,
and the trees close in to the south.

14807.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

east.description: To the east lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14807.description:
Gorse and blackthorn grow thick along the forest's edge here, and
through gaps in the thicket you can see a stony knoll rising out of the
open land beyond, crowned with dark, wind-bent pines. The ground is
rough with tussocks and molehills. The eaves run east toward the knoll
and west, and the forest lies to the south.

14808.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Warrior's Grove.

east.description: To the east lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14808.description:
A rough path climbs out of the forest's edge here toward the stony knoll
of the Warrior's Grove, which rises just to the north with its crown of
wind-bent pines. Steps worn by many boots have been cut into the slope
among the boulders. The eaves run east and west, and the forest lies
close to the south.

14809.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Wilderness Way.

east.description: To the east lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14809.description:
Wilderness Way begins here at the edge of the trees, a rutted track of
packed earth and grass that runs north out of the forest into open
country. A weathered waymark post leans beside the ruts, its carving
softened by years of rain. The eaves stretch away east and west, and a
broad gap between two massive oaks leads south into the green gloom of
MiNar.

extra_descs.waymark post:
The post is oak, silvered with age, and an arrow cut into it points up
the road above the words TO THE PLAINS. Beneath them a newer hand has
scratched a warning: KEEP TO THE WAY.

14810.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

east.description: To the east lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14810.description:
The great forest frays out into open country here in a fringe of silver
birch, hawthorn and bramble. Beyond the last trunks a rolling sweep of
heath and grass runs out under the wide sky toward a far horizon, and
the wind comes freely across it, setting the birch leaves shivering. The
eaves run on east and west along the forest's edge, and the deep woods
begin just to the south.

14811.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

east.description: To the east lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14811.description:
The forest's edge runs straight here, the trees standing in an even line
as if planted, mostly oaks of a great age. Their shade spreads out over
the margin of the heath. The path continues east and west along the
eaves, and a way leads south into the trees. An old iron horseshoe has
been nailed to one of the oaks at head height, rusted almost through.

14812.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

east.description: To the east lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14812.description:
Along the edge of the forest here a low stone wall, rough and moss-
covered, marks off the woods from the open heath. Gaps in the wall lead
south into the trees. The path along the eaves runs east and west beside
it. The heath beyond is broad and windswept, purple with heather in late
summer.

14813.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

east.description: To the east lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14813.description:
A low earth bank topped with gnarled blackthorn runs along the forest
edge here, bent by the winds that sweep across the open heath beyond. In
spring it is white with blossom before the leaves come. The path follows
the bank east and west, and a way leads south through a gap into the
woods. Small scrapes and burrows pock the sandy soil of the bank.

14814.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

east.description: To the east lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14814.description:
Here the forest's edge is fringed with a broad belt of tall nettles and
docks, waist-high and stinging, with a narrow path trodden along it.
Beyond, open heath runs toward the distant grass country. The edge path
continues east and west, and a gap in the nettles leads south into the
trees. Seed heads of thistle and dandelion drift by on the wind.

14815.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

east.description: To the east lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14815.description:
A line of old pollarded willows stands along the forest's edge here,
their heads bristling with thin shoots and their trunks swollen and
hollow. A wet ditch runs at their feet, full of watercress. The edge
path continues east and west, and a plank across the ditch leads south
into the trees. Out beyond the eaves, the heath rolls toward the far
grass country under a wide sky.

14816.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

east.description: To the east lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14816.description:
Here the forest's edge turns its corner, and a strip of open heath runs
between the trees and the distant wall of giant grass. Heather and
harebells grow in the thin soil, and the wind sweeps across them
unhindered. East, the heath leads on to the open ground where the grass
country meets the forest, and west the eaves run along the edge of the
trees. South, a way slips into the forest between a pair of tall pines.

14817.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14817.description:
Open ground of short turf and scattered gorse lies here at the corner of
the forest, where the grass country gives way to the first great trees.
North, a path climbs back toward the towering stems of the grasslands,
and south the eaves of the forest run on in a long green wall. West, the
forest's edge bends away out of sight. The wind comes freely here,
carrying seed from the grass and leaves from the woods together.

14818.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14818.description:
A ditch and bank, overgrown and soft with moss, runs along the forest's
edge here, dug long ago by someone who wished to mark where the wild
began. Beyond the ditch the trees stand tall and close, and a gap in the
bank lets you west into the Great Forest of MiNar. The eaves run on
north and south. Outside the trees, rough pasture rolls away under the
open sky, dotted with gorse.

14819.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14819.description:
Hawthorn grows thick along the eaves here, its twisted trunks leaning
out from under the taller trees as if to escape their shade. In spring
the hedge foams with white blossom, and in autumn it hangs heavy with
dark red haws. A path runs north and south along its foot, and a gap
between two thorns leads west into the woods. A pair of old stone
gateposts stand beside the gap with no gate between them.

14820.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14820.description:
The ground rises into a low hummock here, giving a long view over the
open country beyond the forest, a patchwork of rough grass and heather
fading into haze. Behind you the trees stand dark and tall, and a deer
trail slips west between their trunks. The eaves stretch away north and
south. The wind blows steadily across the hummock, flattening the
heather.

14821.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14821.description:
A great beech has fallen outward from the forest here, its roots torn up
in a wall of earth and stone taller than a man and its crown lying
broken in the open grass. The path along the eaves bends around the root
plate, continuing north and south. West, the gap the beech left in the
forest's edge lets a broad wedge of sunlight into the woods. Bracken has
sprung up thickly in the new light.

14822.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14822.description:
Silver birches stand along the forest edge here, slender and white
against the darker trees behind, their small leaves shivering in every
breath of wind. The turf beneath them is short and starred with yellow
tormentil. The eaves run north and south, and a narrow way leads west
under the birches into the forest proper. Strips of papery bark curl
from the trunks and flutter like pale ribbons.

14823.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14823.description:
A spring rises at the foot of an old oak here and spills out of the
forest in a clear little stream that wanders away across the open land.
Someone has set a flat stone across the trickle as a step, and its top
is worn into a shallow dish by many feet. The path along the eaves runs
north and south, and a way leads west beside the stream into the trees.
The water tastes cold and faintly of iron.

14824.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14824.description:
The eaves are ragged here, the forest's edge broken by a stand of dead
pines, grey and leafless, that some long-ago fire killed without
felling. Their bare branches creak against one another in the wind. The
path runs north and south along the edge, and a way leads west past the
dead pines into the living woods. The ground is black and gritty, and
fireweed grows tall among the stumps.

14825.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14825.description:
Bracken grows shoulder-high along the edge of the forest here, a
rustling sea of brown and green that hides the ground entirely. A path
has been trodden through it, running north and south between the trees
and the open country. West, the bracken thins beneath the shadow of the
first oaks. The air is warm and carries the dry, peppery smell of the
fronds.

14826.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14826.description:
A tumbledown hut of stacked turf and branches leans against the trunk of
an elm at the forest's edge, the shelter of some woodcutter or charcoal
burner long gone. Its roof has fallen in, and nettles fill the doorway.
The path along the eaves continues north and south, and a cart track,
nearly grown over, leads west into the woods. Old chips of wood, grey
and soft, still litter the ground.

14827.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14827.description:
The forest edge curves inward here to form a shallow bay of grass,
sheltered by tall trees on three sides and open to the country beyond.
The turf is cropped short, and the trees around it bear rubbed and
frayed bark at the height of a stag's antlers. The eaves run on north
and south, and a well-used trail leads west into the forest. The air in
the bay is still and warm.

14828.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14828.description:
A lone standing stone, taller than a man and leaning a little toward the
trees, rises from the turf at the forest's edge here. Its sides are
scored with deep grooves where generations of boar and deer have
scratched themselves. The path runs north and south along the eaves, and
a gap opens west into the forest. Lichen in pale green rosettes covers
the weather side of the stone.

extra_descs.standing stone grooves lichen:
The stone is rough grey granite, polished smooth where beasts have
rubbed against it. High up, above the reach of any deer, a crude stag's
head has been pecked into its face by some long-dead hand.

14829.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14829.description:
Holly grows dense and dark along the eaves here, its glossy leaves
shining and its branches so thick that the forest behind is hidden from
view. A tunnel-like gap in the holly leads west into the woods. The path
continues north and south along the edge, where the turf is scattered
with prickly dead leaves. Beyond the forest, open country stretches away
grey-green and empty.

14830.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14830.description:
The ground along the forest edge is soft and boggy here, fed by water
seeping out from under the trees, and tufts of rush and cotton grass
grow in the wet. Planks have been laid end to end along the path to keep
feet dry, though several have rotted through. The way runs north and
south, and a firmer track leads west onto higher ground among the trees.
The smell of peat and wet moss hangs over everything.

14831.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14831.description:
Tall foxgloves stand in purple spires along the eaves here, crowding the
sunny margin between the open country and the forest shade. The trees
behind are mostly oak, broad and low-branched. The path runs north and
south between them and the open land, and a gap leads west under the
oaks. The spires nod and bob whenever the wind finds them.

14832.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14832.description:
An old boundary wall of drystone runs along the edge of the forest here,
mossy and broken, with whole stretches of it fallen into green heaps.
Ferns grow from its chinks, and ivy pours over its top. The path follows
it north and south, and a breach in the wall lets you west into the
trees. Whoever built it meant to keep something in or out, but the
forest has long since won.

14833.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14833.description:
Wild cherry trees grow at the forest's margin here, their bark banded
red and shining, and in spring their white blossom drifts out across the
open ground like snow. The grass beneath them is long and uncut. The
path along the eaves runs north and south, and a narrow way leads west
among the cherries into the darker woods. Small hard stones from old
fruit crunch underfoot.

14834.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14834.description:
A shallow gully cuts down out of the forest here, carrying a stream that
has worn through the soil to grey pebbles and bare rock. A fallen log
bridges it where the path along the eaves crosses, running north and
south. West, a way climbs the gully's bank into the forest. The stream
chatters noisily over its stones before spreading out into the open
land.

14835.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14835.description:
Towering ash trees line the forest's edge here, their pale grey trunks
rising straight and their feathery leaves letting a dappled light
through to the ground. Seed keys hang in brown bunches from the twigs
and spin down when the wind blows. The path runs north and south, and a
way leads west into the forest under the ash. Out beyond the eaves, the
land falls gently away into wide, rolling heath.

14836.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14836.description:
A hunter's high seat, a rickety platform of poles lashed to the trunk of
a sycamore, overlooks the open ground at the forest's edge here. Its
ladder has lost most of its rungs, and moss covers the planks. The path
along the eaves continues north and south, and a way leads west under
the sycamore into the trees. The grass about the platform's foot is
trampled by hooves.

14837.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14837.description:
Gorse and broom grow thick at the forest's margin here, a blaze of
yellow in season and a tangle of green spines the rest of the year.
Their sweet scent hangs heavy on warm days. The path squeezes north and
south between the bushes and the trees, and a way leads west into the
forest. Beyond the gorse, the open country stretches away pale and
windswept.

14838.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14838.description:
A rough cart track comes up to the forest edge here and simply stops, as
though its makers turned back at the sight of the trees. Its ruts are
full of rainwater and its middle is grown with grass. The path along the
eaves runs north and south, and a narrow trail continues west into the
woods where the carts would not go. A broken wheel lies sunk in the mud
at the end of the track.

14839.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14839.description:
The forest edge bends toward its corner here, and the trees grow lower
and wind-bent, their crowns all leaning away from the open country.
Heather grows right up to their roots in purple drifts. The path runs
north along the eaves and south toward a road, and a trail slips west
among the stunted trees. The wind blows harder here, sharp and smelling
of open land.

14840.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies The Kalveh Gatehouse.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14840.description:
A great oak marks the corner of the forest here, and beside it a
gravelled road runs south to the Kalveh Gatehouse, a squat tower of grey
stone guarding the way into Baron Kalveh's lands. Its iron gate is shut
and chained, the bars rusted, and no warden answers a call. North, the
path runs back up the forest's edge, and west it follows the eaves along
the trees' far flank. Weeds grow unchecked through the gravel.

extra_descs.gate iron chain gatehouse:
The iron gate is fastened with a heavy chain and a padlock furred with
rust. A painted board above it once bore the baron's arms, but the paint
has flaked away to bare grey wood.

14841.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14841.description:
The path along the lower edge of the forest begins here, hugging the
trees where a long bank of heather and bilberry slopes away into open
moorland. East, the way leads to the great oak at the forest's corner
and the road beside it. A trail climbs north into the woods, and the
eaves run on west. The ground is peaty and dark, and the bilberry bushes
hang with small blue-black fruit in season.

14842.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14842.description:
The eaves run along the forest's lower edge here, and beyond the trees a
long slope of moorland falls away toward a far blue line of hills.
Bilberry and crowberry cover the ground in a low, springy mat. The path
runs east and west along the edge, and a way leads north into the trees
between two crooked rowans. The wind off the moor is cold and smells of
peat.

14843.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14843.description:
A tumbled cairn of white quartz stands at the forest's edge here,
glinting in the light, raised perhaps as a guide for travellers on the
moor. The path along the eaves continues east and west. North, a way
leads into the forest, where mist hangs among the trees. The ground is
rough and stony, and tough tufts of moor grass grow between the rocks.

14844.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14844.description:
Here the forest of MiNar comes to an end in a ragged line of oaks and
blackthorn, and beyond the last trees rough hill pasture climbs away,
scattered with grey stones, toward a far line of hazy blue mountains.
The light is broad and bright after the forest's shade, and the wind
blows cool off the hills. The eaves run east and west, and the trees
close in again to the north.

14845.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14845.description:
An old dry-stone wall runs along the forest's edge here, tumbled and
overgrown, as though someone once meant to fence the woods away from the
hill pasture beyond. Red campion and stitchwort grow among its fallen
stones. A sheep track follows the wall east and west along the eaves,
and a gap in the trees leads north into the forest.

14846.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14846.description:
Outside the forest's edge the land climbs into rough hill pasture,
cropped short and scattered with grey stones, toward a line of hazy blue
mountains far beyond. A dry-stone wall, half fallen, follows the eaves
here as if to fence the forest in. The trees stand tall to the north,
and a sheep track runs east and west along the wall. The wind blows
steadily off the hills, cool and clean.

14847.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14847.description:
A squat stone kiln stands just outside the eaves, its round walls half
fallen and its arched mouth still black with old burning. Pale, chalky
stones lie heaped around it, and nettles grow thick where the lime once
spilled. Beyond it the hillside rises bare toward the distant peaks. A
track runs east and west along the edge of the forest, and the trees lie
close to the north.

14848.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14848.description:
A lone hawthorn grows on the open slope outside the eaves, bent almost
double by the wind and hung with tufts of wool snagged from passing
flocks. The hillside beyond climbs in long, stony swells toward far blue
mountains. The forest stands close to the north, its edge running east
and west along the foot of the slope. The grass here is short and
springy and starred with tiny yellow flowers.

14849.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14849.description:
Water seeps out of the hillside here and soaks the ground just outside
the eaves, so that rushes and tufts of cotton grass grow in soggy
patches. Stepping from tussock to tussock keeps your boots mostly dry.
The forest's edge runs east and west, with the trees rising tall to the
north, while the hills climb away bare and grey beyond the wet ground. A
cold breeze comes down off the slopes.

14850.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Entering the Great Valley.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14850.description:
An old road climbs out of the forest here and heads south into the hills
toward the distant Great Valley, but a heavy gate of grey timbers bars
it between two stone posts, chained and locked with rust. Beyond the
gate the road vanishes under thorn and landslip. The eaves of the forest
run east and west, and a sunken track leads back north beneath the
trees. The wind whistles thinly through the gaps in the gate.

extra_descs.gate timbers chain posts padlock:
The gate is built of squared timbers grey with age and bound with iron
straps. A chain as thick as a wrist loops through it and around one
post, fastened with a padlock rusted into a single lump. Someone has cut
a warning deep into the post: ROCKFALL. NO ROAD.

14851.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14851.description:
