A great cairn of grey stones crowns a knoll outside the forest here,
built higher than a man and capped with a flat slab. From beside it you
can look out over the endless green roof of the forest, and on a clear
day catch a far grey glint of the sea. The forest's edge runs east and
west at the foot of the knoll, and the trees rise close to the north.
Lichen grows in pale rings on the stones.

extra_descs.cairn stones slab:
The cairn is old beyond guessing, its lowest stones sunk deep in the
turf and furred with lichen. Travellers have added pebbles to it over
the years, and the flat slab on top is worn smooth, as if many have sat
there to rest and look out over the trees.

14852.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14852.description:
A roofless stone bothy stands just outside the eaves, where some
shepherd once sheltered with his flock. Its walls are still sound to
shoulder height and a soot-stained hearth fills one end, but the roof
timbers fell in long ago. Beyond it the hills climb away, stony and
bare. The edge of the forest runs east and west, and the trees rise tall
to the north.

14853.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14853.description:
A tall boundary stone stands in the rough grass outside the eaves,
leaning a little and splotched with yellow lichen. Its two broad faces
are carved, one with a spreading tree and the other with a mountain
peak, as if to mark where the forest's country ends and the hills begin.
The eaves run east and west, and the forest rises to the north, where a
ragged crag shows among the trees. Thistles grow thick around the
stone's foot.

extra_descs.boundary stone carving tree mountain:
The carvings are simple and bold: on one face a broad tree with roots as
wide as its crown, and on the other a jagged peak. Along the stone's
narrow edge a line of notches runs from top to bottom, too worn and too
many to count.

14854.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14854.description:
A little burn comes tumbling off the hills here and slips in under the
trees, chattering over stones. Long ago someone dammed it with a low
stone wall to make a pool for washing sheep, and the pool is still
there, clear and cold, with a gap in the wall where the water spills
through. The forest's edge runs east and west, and the burn vanishes
north among the alders.

14855.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14855.description:
A narrow path winds through gorse and broom just outside the forest
here, and the bushes tick and crackle in the sun as their seed pods
split. The open land rolls away toward far mountains, and somewhere
beyond the gorse the ground must fall toward the sea, for the wind
carries salt. The path runs east and west along the eaves, and the trees
stand to the north.

14856.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies On the Ocean Shore.

14856.description:
The forest ends at its last corner here, where wind-bent firs lean out
over the brink of the sea cliffs. A narrow cleft in the rock slopes down
west to a sheltered gallery on the shore below, and the boom of the surf
rolls up through it. The eaves run north along the cliff-top heath and
east toward the foot of the hills. Spray beads on the fir needles, and
the salt smell is everywhere.

14857.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14857.description:
Firs lean out from the eaves here over turf so thin and salt-burned that
grey rock shows through it, and cushions of pink thrift grow in every
crack. Spray drifts up from the foot of the cliffs nearby, and the air
tastes of salt. The trees to the east grow close and dark. The way runs
north along the heath and south toward the forest's last corner.

14858.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14858.description:
The heath narrows here between the forest and the brink of the sea
cliffs, so close now that the boom of surf in the caves below comes
clearly on the wind. Tall pines with red bark stand along the eaves to
the east, their needles carpeting the sandy turf. Gulls' feathers lie
caught in the heather. The way runs north and south along the forest's
edge.

14859.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14859.description:
Hollies form the edge of the forest here, dense and dark, with a single
gap that leads in among the trees to the east. In a sandy bank beneath
them a fox has dug its earth, and the entrance is strewn with feathers
and small bones. The heath outside is rough and tussocky, sloping away
toward the sea. A path runs north and south along the hollies.

14860.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14860.description:
A sluggish stream seeps out from beneath dark yews at the forest's edge
here and spreads across the heath in a reedy bog, gleaming with pools.
Mist clings to the wet ground and the yews alike. Firm ground runs north
and south along the eaves, and the way into the forest to the east
follows the stream's bank under the trees.

14861.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14861.description:
Long, even ridges run across the heath here beneath the heather, the
faint pattern of a field ploughed by some crofter long ago. Rushes grow
in the furrows between them, where the water lies after rain. The eaves
run north toward the ruins of a croft and south toward thickening mist,
and the forest opens to the east under dripping oaks.

14862.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14862.description:
The tumbled walls of an old croft stand just outside the eaves here,
roofless and green with moss, and beside them a stone-lined well lies
covered by a cracked slab. A rowan grows from what was once the hearth.
Whoever lived here farmed the edge of the heath and took their wood from
the forest close by to the east. The way runs north and south along the
eaves.

14863.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14863.description:
A thicket of gorse was burned here once, and its black, twisted
skeletons still stand in a broad patch along the eaves, with new green
shoots pushing up between them. The fire reached the forest's edge as
well, and the oaks to the east bear scorch marks on their trunks. Ashy
soil blackens your boots. The way runs north and south along the edge of
the trees.

14864.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14864.description:
The wreck of an old cart lies in the heather just outside the forest,
one wheel broken and its bed tilted into the ground, its timbers
bleached silver by sun and salt wind. Whoever drove it along the eaves
never came back for it. Faint ruts lead north and south along the
forest's edge, and the trees stand close to the east. Beyond the heath
the land falls away toward a grey shimmer of sea.

extra_descs.cart wreck wheel timbers:
The cart's bed is split and rotten, and heather grows up through the
gaps between its planks. On the tailboard you can just make out a
painted wheel with eight spokes, faded almost to nothing, perhaps a
carter's mark.

14865.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14865.description:
Sandy heath stretches away from the forest's edge here, patched with
heather, crowberry and short, wiry grass. The soil is so thin that pale
sand shows through in every scrape. Far off, the heath runs out to the
brink of the sea cliffs, and beyond them the water glints like hammered
pewter. The eaves run north and south, and a ditch of black water lines
the inside of the trees to the east.

14866.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14866.description:
A broad hollow in the heath gathers the mist that rolls in from the sea,
so that the grey of it fills the dip like a lake, and the forest's edge
to the east is only a dim wall of shapes. Everything is wet, from the
heather to the hem of your cloak. The way climbs gently out of the
hollow north and south along the eaves. The mist muffles every sound but
the drip of water from the nearest trees.

14867.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14867.description:
A thicket of blackthorn crowds the edge of the forest here, its black,
thorny twigs woven so tightly that only a narrow gap lets you pass in
among the trees to the east. Dusky blue sloes hang among the thorns.
Outside the thicket the heath stretches away, wide and windy, toward the
sea. A path follows the eaves north and south.

14868.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14868.description:
A tall standing stone leans out of the heather here, just outside the
forest, as if it has been bowing slowly toward the sea for a thousand
years. A ship with a high prow and a single square sail is carved on its
seaward face, worn faint by the weather. The forest's edge runs north
and south, and a gap in the trees leads east. The wind moans softly
around the stone.

extra_descs.standing stone ship carving sail:
The ship is cut in simple, deep lines: a curved hull, a high prow shaped
like a beast's head, a single mast and a square sail. A row of small
circles along the hull might be shields or oar-ports, and beneath the
ship a wavy line runs the width of the stone.

14869.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14869.description:
An old dry-stone wall comes out from under the trees here, having
crossed the forest beneath its moss, and wanders a short way onto the
heath before sinking into the turf. Bracken grows in a russet slope
along the eaves. A path follows the forest's edge north and south, and
the trees open to the east where the wall goes in.

14870.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14870.description:
A rib of grey rock breaks through the heath here, and a stunted rowan
has rooted in a crack along its top, bent low by the wind. From the rock
you can look out over a long, falling sweep of heather toward the
distant sea. The eaves of the forest run north and south, close and
dark, and a path slips in among the trees to the east. Rock and heather
alike are spotted with pale lichen.

14871.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14871.description:
A sandy bank along the forest's edge here is riddled with rabbit
burrows, dozens of dark holes with fans of pale sand spilling from each,
and the turf around them is nibbled as short as a lawn. Honeysuckle
trails from the outermost trees to the east, sweet on the wind. The
eaves run north toward a brook and south along the heath.

14872.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14872.description:
The brook that rises in the forest flows out from under the trees here
and winds away across the heath in a narrow, peaty channel, bound for
the sea. A pair of flat stones lets you cross without wetting your feet.
Rushes grow thick along its banks. The eaves run north and south, and
the brook leads back east into the forest toward a sandy ford among
alders.

14873.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14873.description:
A tall post of sea-bleached timber stands in a heap of stones here, set
up long ago as a waymark for travellers along the eaves. It is cracked
and silver-grey, and a rusted iron ring hangs from a staple near its
top. The heath beyond rolls away toward the sea, smelling of salt and
heather. A grove of hollies darkens the forest's edge to the east, and
the way runs north and south.

14874.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14874.description:
Old peat cuttings scar the heath here, long straight trenches with
black, crumbling walls where turf for burning was once cut and carried
away. Water stands in their bottoms, brown as strong tea. The forest's
edge runs north and south, lined with low oaks swept by the wind, and a
way slips in among them to the east. The smell of peat and wet heather
is strong.

14875.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14875.description:
A row of hawthorns grows along the eaves here, every one carved by the
wind into the same shape, low on the seaward side and streaming toward
the forest like hair blown back from a face. Between them the heath runs
right up to the trees. The way follows the forest's edge north and
south, and a gap lets you in among the ferns to the east.

14876.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14876.description:
A circular sheepfold of dry-stone walls stands on the heath here,
roofless and empty, its gateway open toward the forest. Nettles and
docks grow thick inside it on the old, rich ground. Beyond it the heath
stretches away to a far, pale horizon. The eaves run north and south,
and a fallen pine shows among the trees to the east.

14877.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14877.description:
Heather covers the ground here in a springy purple carpet that runs
right in under the trees to the east, where the forest's edge is thin
and airy with birch and rowan. The heath falls away in long, gentle
folds toward a sky that seems far bigger than any sky above the forest.
A sheep track runs north and south along the eaves.

14878.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14878.description:
The wind blows hard and steady off the heath just outside the forest's
edge, and the outermost trees lean away from it, stunted and twisted. A
tall lone pine shows to the north, standing at the forest's corner. On
one side the heath falls away, wide and empty, and on the other the
trees part to let a path in toward the east. The way also follows the
eaves south.

14879.name: Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Forest Of MiNar.

east.description: To the east lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

14879.description:
The turf outside the eaves is short and salt-burned here, worn thin over
grey rock and starred with cushions of pink thrift. A row of firs along
the forest's edge has been shaped by the sea wind into lopsided green
flags. The boom of surf carries from beyond the forest's corner to the
west, where the land ends at the cliffs. The eaves run east along the
foot of the hills, and the stunted trees stand close to the north.

101000.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101000.description:
The grass hall widens into an almost square room, its walls of stem so
straight they look trimmed. A ring of pale, fat mushrooms circles the
middle of the floor, and the grass inside the ring is greener than the
rest. Lanes leave the room through each of its four walls, north, south,
east and west. Travellers seem to step around the ring rather than
through it, and their trodden path curves plainly to one side.

101001.name: The Grasslands

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101001.description:
A low mound rises from the floor of this grass hall, round and grassed
over, with a ring of half-buried stones set about its foot. The stems
lean in over it as if listening. Lanes lead east and west along its
sides, and a narrower way goes south. No one has disturbed the mound,
and the grass upon it grows finer and paler than anywhere around.

extra_descs.mound barrow stones ring:
The mound is too regular to be natural, a barrow raised over someone
long forgotten. The ring stones are grey and smooth, and one bears a
faded spiral cut deep into its face.

101002.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101002.description:
Water seeps out of the ground here, keeping a small patch of earth dark
and soft underfoot. Wild mint grows thickly around the seep, and the
crushed leaves release a cool, sharp scent with every step. A few clumps
of rushes rise among the grass stems. Paths lead off north, east, south
and west, and the ground stays damp for some way along each.

101003.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101003.description:
A small round pond lies in a hollow here, ringed with rushes and soft,
hoof-churned mud. Its water is clear and still, mirroring the arching
grass that leans out over it. The air above the pond is cooler and
smells of wet earth and green weed. Muddy trails, much used, lead away
from the water north, east, south and west.

101004.name: The Grasslands

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101004.description:
The corridor widens into a round chamber of grass where someone long ago
cut the stems back and laid a ring of fieldstones for a fire. The hearth
is cold and choked with blown seed, and the stalks around it have grown
back scorched black at their feet. Ways lead east and west, and a broad
lane opens south into a wider stretch of the grass country. A faint
smell of ancient ash still lingers.

101005.name: The Grasslands

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101005.description:
Here the stems grow in clumps, and between them the floor is a soft mat
of flattened grass pressed into round hollows where large beasts have
lain to rest. Coarse hairs, brown and black, are snagged on the lower
stalks. Light falls through the roof in a hundred thin gold needles that
tremble whenever the wind passes over. The way continues east and west,
and a lane opens to the south.

101006.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101006.description:
A ring of old fence posts stands here among the stems, grey and split
and leaning at all angles, the rails they once carried long since rotted
away. Perhaps a corral for horses stood on this spot once. The grass has
swallowed it entirely and closes overhead. Gaps in the old ring let
paths out north, east, south and west.

101007.name: The Grasslands

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies Wilderness Way.

101007.description:
Stems as thick as a man's wrist rise on every side and bend together
overhead, so that the grass forms a long green hall with only glints of
daylight in its roof. The light is still bright here from the open Way,
which shows as a pale gap to the west. A trampled lane runs east deeper
into the grass, and a narrower run opens south. The ground is hard and
dusty, scattered with the husks of old seed.

101008.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

101008.description:
Several oval beds have been pressed into the grass here where large
animals lay down to rest, the stems flattened and still smelling of
their sleepers. The grass around them stands thick and high, and on one
side a hawthorn hedge marks the edge of the Grasslands. Paths lead
north, east, and south toward the gap onto the road.

101009.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101009.description:
The curved stone wall of an old sheepfold rises on one side of the path
here, broken and overgrown. Its stones are mossy and loose, and nettles
grow thick inside it. The grass towers over the ruin and closes in on
the path beside it. Paths lead north, east and west along the old fold.

101010.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101010.description:
Bindweed has climbed the stems here and knitted them together with its
pale trumpet flowers, so that the roof is a white-starred weave letting
in a soft, even light. The flowers smell faintly of almonds in the
warmth. Lanes lead north, south, east and west, each one hung with
trailing tendrils that must be brushed aside. Underfoot the earth is dry
and crumbles into dust.

101011.name: The Grasslands

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101011.description:
The grass here is young and very green, sprung up from ground that was
burned not many seasons ago, and its roof is thin enough to glow almost
white. Charred stubs of older stems still poke from the soil between the
new shoots. Lanes open east and west, and a broad way leads south to a
crossing. The air smells of fresh sap and, more faintly, of old smoke.

101012.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101012.description:
Here the grass forms a great hollow dome, the tall stems bending in from
every side to meet high overhead like the roof of a thatched hall. Light
filters through in thin golden threads, and the floor is a soft carpet
of fallen blades and seed husks. It is strangely quiet under the dome.
Arching doorways in the grass lead north, east, south and west.

101013.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101013.description:
A cairn of grey stones stands here, waist-high and carefully built,
though moss has filled the gaps between them and grass sprouts from its
top. No one remembers who raised it, or why. The stems arch over it in a
close, rustling dome. Paths lead off from the cairn north, east and
south, and west toward a pond.

extra_descs.cairn stones:
The stones are smooth, rounded river stones, carried here from some
distant stream bed, and the topmost bears a scratched sign like a
horse's head. Travellers who find the cairn sometimes add a pebble of
their own for luck.

101014.name: The Grasslands

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101014.description:
Russet grass grows here, its tall stems stained the colour of rust and
its plumes heavy and dark, so that the hall beneath is dim, warm and
faintly red. Fallen seed lies ankle-deep along the walls and crunches
underfoot. The lanes run east and west, and another leads south between
two especially tall clumps. The wind's voice is low here, a long and
steady murmur in the roof.

101015.name: The Grasslands

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101015.description:
The grass here has a silver cast, its long blades furred underneath so
that the whole hall shimmers pale whenever the wind turns them. A
shallow dew pond lies in a dip of the floor, ringed with cracked mud and
the sharp prints of hooves. Lanes lead east and west along the length of
the grass country, and a gap opens south. The light is cool and watery,
as if it came through frosted glass.

101016.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101016.description:
The grass here is heavy with seed, its long heads bowed so low under
their own weight that they brush your face and shoulders as you pass.
Seeds shower down at every touch, catching in your hair and clothes and
working into your boots. The air is hazy with chaff where the light
comes through. Seed-strewn paths lead north, east, south and west.

101017.name: The Grasslands

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101017.description:
The grass roof hangs lower here, its heavy seedheads nodding down until
they brush your shoulders and leave a dust of golden pollen. Wind moves
through the tops in a long hiss, and the whole green ceiling heaves and
settles like the breath of some vast animal. Lanes lead off east and
west through the stems, and a gap to the south shows another hall of
grass. Underfoot the soil is dark and springy with old roots.

101018.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101018.description:
A long, low heap of fieldstones lies here, gathered long ago by farmers
clearing the land for the plough. Lichen and moss have crept over every
stone, and the grass grows thick among them. It is hard to imagine
anyone ever farming this sea of grass. Paths lead off around the heap
north, east, south and west.

101019.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101019.description:
A lone silver birch has grown up here among the grass, its slender white
trunk rising through the stems and its small leaves trembling in the
wind. Its bark peels in papery curls. Around its roots the ground is
clearer, and the light is pale and dappled. Paths lead north, east
toward a standing stone, south and west.

101020.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101020.description:
A great anthill rises waist-high in this grass hall, a hard dome of red
earth long abandoned and crumbling at its crown. The grass grows thin
around it, and more light reaches the floor here, warm and yellow. Lanes
run north, south, east and west from the clearing about the mound. The
red dust of the old hill has stained the nearby stems up to their knees.

101021.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies Obscure Path.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101021.description:
The grass here grows in dense tufts of blue-green, stiff as broom straw,
and the wind whistles thinly through them in the roof. A narrow way
leads north to a low gap where the stalks have been bent and tied, and
the hall runs south along the edge of the grass country. West, a lane
opens into a broader hall. The prints of shod horses cross the soft
ground, all of them heading the same way.

101022.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101022.description:
A trail has been hacked through the grass here with blades, leaving a
stubble of cut stems underfoot and a clean-edged corridor lit by a strip
of brightness overhead. Many bootprints tramp along it in both
directions. The cut trail runs on east and back west, where it fades
into trampled stems, while rougher paths lead north toward an old earth
bank and south.

101023.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101023.description:
The lane runs south along the edge of the grass country here, toward a
line of darkness that is the eaves of the great forest. The stems on
this side grow shorter and patchier, and here and there gaps in the roof
are filled with the green of distant treetops. Ways lead north back into
the deeper grass and west into a neighbouring hall. Fallen oak leaves,
blown far out of the woods, lie scattered among the stems.

101024.name: The Grasslands

east.description: To the east lies Obscure Path.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101024.description:
The grass hall ends at a tangle of fallen, rotting stems, and beyond it
the way narrows to a slot that is easy to miss. Someone has notched a
few of the stalks beside it with a knife, small marks at knee height
that only a searching eye would find. That faint path leads east into
deeper shadow, while the open lane runs back west. The air smells
strongly of crushed green sap.

101025.name: The Grasslands

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101025.description:
The stems press in close on both sides, leaving a corridor no wider than
a cart, its roof so dense that the light comes through a dim, deep
green. No side ways open here, and the grass walls are too thick and
tough to push through. The lane runs on east and back west. Somewhere
above, the wind roars across the tops with the sound of distant surf,
yet down here hardly a blade stirs.

101026.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101026.description:
The grass grows so tall and close here that it arches together overhead
into a long, dim tunnel, and the light that reaches the bottom is green
and faint, as if seen through water. The air is warm, still and close,
and your footsteps fall soft on a thick mat of dead stems. Openings in
the tunnel's walls lead north, east, south and west.

101027.name: The Grasslands

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101027.description:
A grey boulder the size of a haycart squats in the middle of this grass
hall, its top worn smooth and its flanks crusted with orange lichen. The
stems have grown up close around it and folded over its crown, so that
it sits in green shade like something kept indoors. Lanes run east and
west past the stone, and a narrow way leads south. The air smells warm
and sweet, like a hayloft at the end of summer.

101028.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101028.description:
Wild oats grow among the taller grasses here, their drooping spikelets
dangling like tiny bells and rattling softly in the wind. The stems
around them are thin and wiry, and the light between them is bright. A
dry, dusty smell rises from the ground. Rattling paths lead off north,
east, south and west.

101029.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101029.description:
A weathered stump stands here, all that remains of some tree that once
grew among the grass, and the stems open in a ragged gap above it. Its
top is streaked white where a hunting bird often perches, and pellets of
fur and tiny bones lie at its foot. Paths lead away from the stump
north, east, south and west.

101030.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101030.description:
The grass here is a different kind, its stems a deep rusty red and its
seed heads split three ways like the feet of a bird. The light that
filters down through it has a ruddy, coppery glow, as though the whole
place were lit by a banked fire. The stems creak and tick against one
another in the wind. Paths run off north and east into more of the red
grass, and south and west into green.

101031.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101031.description:
Clumps of feathery pampas grow here among the common grass, their great
plumes leaning together overhead into a soft, cream-coloured ceiling.
When the wind stirs them they shed a fine fluff that hangs in the air
and catches the light. Ways lead off north, east, south and west. The
floor is cushioned with the plumes of many years.

101032.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101032.description:
A well-used horse trail runs through the grass here, the ground pocked
with hoofprints and the stems polished smooth where flanks have brushed
against them. The smell of horse is strong, and old dung lies along the
path. The trail runs north and south, and narrower side paths branch off
east and west.

101033.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101033.description:
Red poppies and blue cornflowers grow thickly among the grass stems
here, a splash of colour in the green and gold. Their petals glow like
lamps where the light strikes them, and the air smells faintly sweet.
Paths lead north toward a pond, east toward the game trails, south
toward a deep ditch, and west.

101034.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

101034.description:
The grass grows in rows here, straight lines of stems with even lanes
between them, as though the field was planted long ago and left to run
wild. The roof is high and regular, and the light falls in long bars
down each lane. Ways lead north, east and south. At the end of one row
stands a toppled stone marker, its face weathered past reading.

101035.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101035.description:
A gnarled hawthorn has grown up here in the midst of the grass, its
trunk twisted by years of wind and its thorny branches knotted together
with the stems overhead. Beneath it is a small round space carpeted with
fallen leaves and dark red haws, quieter and more sheltered than the
grass around it. Ways lead out from under the thorn north, east, south
and west.

101036.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101036.description:
The grass here is a pale, silvery kind whose fine leaves shimmer like
water when the wind moves them. The light that filters through is white
and cool rather than gold, and the whole place has a strange, dreamlike
stillness. Paths lead north toward an old ring of fence posts, and east,
south and west through the silver stems.

101037.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

101037.description:
Feather grass grows here among the taller stems, its long silky plumes
trailing down from the roof of grass like the hair of some great
sleeping creature. On one side a tangled bank of briar and sloe shuts
out the road entirely, though you can hear the wind passing over it.
Trodden ways lead north and east, and south toward the gap onto the
road.

101038.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101038.description:
Yellow ragwort and white yarrow grow thickly among the grass here, and
the ground beneath them is dry, dusty and cracked. The bitter smell of
the yarrow rises when you brush against it. The stems overhead are
thinner, and the light is bright and hot. Dusty paths lead off north,
east, south and west.

101039.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101039.description:
An old sunken track crosses here, worn down between earthen banks by
carts that passed this way in some forgotten time. The grass has
reclaimed it completely, and the stems meet over its banks in a low
arch. The old track runs north and south, and lesser paths climb out of
it east and west.

101040.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101040.description:
An old stone well stands in this grass hall, its round wall built of
fieldstones and its mouth covered by a rotting wooden lid. The stems
have crowded right up against it, and a few have sprouted from the
cracks in its masonry. Lanes run north, south, east and west. A cold
breath rises through the gaps in the lid, smelling of deep water and wet
stone.

extra_descs.well stone lid:
The well is old and deep, and its lid has rotted through in places. Far
below, a dark gleam of water shows, and a dropped pebble takes a long
time to answer with a hollow plop.

101041.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101041.description:
Four lanes meet in this grassy crossing, where the stems have been
grazed back into a wide round room with a high, airy roof. A post of
weathered wood stands in the middle, its top hung with a bleached horse
skull that someone fixed there long ago. Lanes run off north, east,
south and west, all looking much alike. When the wind gusts, it moans
faintly through the empty eye sockets of the skull.

101042.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101042.description:
A long-dead tree lies fallen across the path here, its trunk weathered
silver-grey and smooth as bone. Its broken branches prop up the grass
above, so that the stems make a rough roof like thatch laid over
rafters. You must duck under the trunk or clamber over it to go north,
east, south or west.

101043.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101043.description:
Game trails from every side meet here in a broad trampled space, the
earth beaten hard and bare by countless hooves and paws. The prints of
horses and wolves are pressed one over another into the dust. The grass
around the crossing has been bent outward as if by a crowd. Trails run
off north, east, south and west, each as well worn as the next.

101044.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101044.description:
A fallen tree trunk, silver with age and hollow along its length, lies
across this grass hall, carried here by some flood or storm long before
the grass grew up around it. The stems have pushed up through its broken
ends and split bark. Lanes lead north, south and west, and the trunk
must be clambered over to go any way at all. The old wood smells of dry
rot and wild honey.

101045.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101045.description:
A thicket of wild roses closes off one side of this narrow pocket in the
grass, its arching canes studded with thorns and hung with bright red
hips. The grass stems tower above the roses and lean over them, roofing
the place in rustling green. You can push on north, or follow the
trodden paths south and west.

101046.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101046.description:
A low bank of earth rises among the grass here, and a dark hole has been
dug into its side, wide enough for a large dog to crawl into. The earth
around the mouth is scratched bare and smells strongly of wolf. The
grass has been trampled flat in a circle before the den. Paths lead away
from the bank north, east, south and west.

101047.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101047.description:
The stems have been crushed flat here in a rough ring where some heavy
beast has rolled and rolled, until the ground beneath is bare, dusty
earth. Coarse hairs, dun and black, cling to the broken stalks around
the edge. Light pours warm and golden into the hollow through the gap
torn in the grass roof. Trails leave the ring in all four directions,
north, south, east and west.

101048.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101048.description:
An old well lies here, its stone lip crumbled and grown over with moss
and grass, and its shaft choked to the brim with brambles. Whoever dug
it must have lived here once, though no trace of a house remains. The
stems arch over the well like a canopy. Paths lead away from it north,
east and west.

101049.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

101049.description:
The stems here all lean the same way, bent by the wind that comes over
the open ground beyond the edge of the grass. A tangle of dog roses and
briar closes off that side, but the wind still finds its way through,
rattling the seed heads. The light is brightest by the briars. Paths
lead north, east and south.

101050.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101050.description:
The stems here are banded green and yellow like a snake's skin, an odd
kind of grass that grows nowhere else nearby, and they rattle drily
together in the roof. Wide lanes open north, south, east and west. A
hunter's mark, three slashes in a triangle, has been cut into a cluster
of stalks at eye height. The floor is bare, hard-packed earth.

101051.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101051.description:
Thistles as tall as the grass itself have taken root here, their purple
heads nodding high among the stems and their spiny leaves crowding the
floor. A path winds between them north and south, and a wider way opens
west. The light is a soft purple-green, and thistledown drifts down
through it like slow snow. The ground is dry and stony, the soil lying
thin over buried rock.

101052.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101052.description:
Lightning or some careless fire has scorched a small pocket of the grass
down to black stubble here, and the smell of old smoke still clings to
it. Bright new shoots push up through the ash, and the stems around the
burn lean inward, sooty and singed, to close the gap overhead. Paths
cross the blackened ground north, east, south and west.

101053.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101053.description:
Brambles have crept into the grass here from the woods, weaving thorny
arches between the stems and roofing the lane in a dark, prickly
lattice. Blackberries ripen among them in season, and old purple stains
mark the floor beneath. The lane runs north and south, and a gap in the
brambles opens west. Tufts of wool and fur hang snagged on the thorns at
shoulder height.

101056.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101056.description:
A muddy wallow lies in a dip here, churned to a thick brown porridge by
hooves and rolling bodies. The stems around it are caked with dried mud
to the height of a horse's shoulder, and the warm air hangs heavy with a
rank, earthy smell. Every path out of the dip, north, east, south and
west, is splashed with mud.

101057.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101057.description:
A great anthill of crumbly red earth rises waist-high among the stems
here, its sides riddled with tiny tunnels. The grass grows thinner
around it, and the light comes down more freely, warm on the back of
your neck. A sharp, vinegary smell hangs in the air. Paths circle the
mound and lead away north, east, south and west, each looking much like
the others.

101058.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101058.description:
The grass here is a giant kind, its jointed stems as thick as a spear
shaft and hard as cane, rising twice a man's height before they bend.
When the wind blows they clack and knock together with a hollow, wooden
sound. The ground between the canes is bare and dry. Paths wind off
north toward an old cart, and east, south and west.

101059.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

101059.description:
A bank of turf crowned with spiny gorse rises along one side of the
grass here, shutting out the road beyond. You can hear the wind sweeping
across the open country past it, a different sound from the hiss of the
grass around you. Paths lead north toward the road gap, and east and
south into the stems.

101060.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101060.description:
A shallow dry wash cuts through the grass here, its bottom a ribbon of
pale sand and rounded pebbles left by some long-departed stream. Its
low, crumbling banks are bound together with roots, and overhead the
grass meets in a ragged arch. Walking the wash is easier than pushing
through the stems, and it leads north and south, while paths climb out
of it east and west.

101061.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101061.description:
The floor dips here into a long, damp hollow where reeds have crept in
among the grass, and the soil squelches black underfoot. A thin trickle
of water seeps from one side and pools at the bottom before soaking
away. Lanes climb out of the hollow north, east and west. The air is
cool and smells of mud and mint, and the light comes greenish through
reed and grass alike.

101062.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101062.description:
A standing stone rises from the earth here, taller than a man and
leaning slightly, its sides worn smooth by wind and the rubbing of
beasts. Faint spirals are carved into its face. The grass has grown up
all around it, so that the stone stands in a close green chamber of its
own. Paths lead away from the stone north, east, south and west.

extra_descs.standing stone spirals:
The spirals wind inward on one face and outward on the other, cut by
hands long dead. When the wind blows hard through the grass, a low
humming seems to come from the stone itself.

101063.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101063.description:
A deep ditch runs along one side of the path here, its bottom thick with
nettles and its far bank crowned with a dense hedge of thorn. There is
no crossing it. The grass leans over the ditch from both sides, closing
it into a damp green tunnel. The path follows the ditch east and west,
and a gap in the stems leads north.

101064.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101064.description:
Wild barley has seeded itself among the grass here, its bearded ears
hanging thick from the roof and scratching at your face as you pass. A
sweet, dusty smell fills the hall. Lanes lead off north, south, east and
west, the western one sloping gently downhill. Small shrivelled ears lie
scattered over the floor where the wind has shaken them loose.

101065.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101065.description:
A patch of white and purple clover spreads over the ground here beneath
the arching grass, thick and lush as a cushion. Its honeyed scent hangs
heavily in the warm air. The tall stems leave a little more room around
the clover, and the light reaches it in warm, shifting patches. Narrow
ways lead out of the clover north, east, south and west.

101066.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101066.description:
An old hedge of hawthorn and bramble runs along one side of the path
here, thick with blackberries and rustling with the wind. Its roots form
a low, mossy bank. Above, the grass reaches across to the hedge-top,
making a long green passage. The passage runs east and west along the
hedge, and a path turns away north.

101067.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies Wilderness Way.

101067.description:
The grass closes overhead a few paces in from the road, its stems
leaning together into a whispering roof that turns the light green and
gold. A trampled gap opens west onto Wilderness Way, and the stalks
nearest it are grey with road dust. Narrow paths wind off north, east
and south through the dense, rustling stems.

101068.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

101068.description:
A row of old pollarded willows stands along one side of the grass here,
their squat trunks hollow and their heads bristling with whippy shoots.
They mark the edge of the Grasslands, and beyond them the road runs
unseen. Paths lead north, east and south through the stems beside the
willows.

101069.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101069.description:
Heat gathers between the close-packed stems here, and the air is thick,
still and drowsy, smelling of hay and dust. The stems tick and creak
softly as they warm. Overhead the grass is so dense that the light is a
dim, hot gold. Paths lead north, east, south and west, each as stifling
as the last.

101070.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101070.description:
Here the grass grows a darker, wetter green, and the ground slopes very
gently toward the forest country to the south. Lanes cross the hall
north to south and east to west, worn into shallow ruts by the passing
of many hooves. Big drops of dew hang from the roof long into the day
and fall with a soft patter. The air carries a first faint scent of leaf
mould and pine.

101071.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101071.description:
A wide, low hall stretches here, its roof sagging so close overhead that
you must stoop beneath the heaviest seedheads. The floor is crisscrossed
by narrow trails no higher than a dog, running off under the walls of
stems. Lanes lead east, west and north. The light is dim and gold, and
every gust sends a patter of loose seed down onto your shoulders.

101072.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101072.description:
Tall thistles grow among the grass here, their purple heads bristling
and their down drifting through the air in slow white wisps. Their spiny
leaves catch at your legs, and burrs cling to everything that passes.
The grass rises well above the thistles and meets over the path. Trails
lead north, east toward the whorled grass, south and west.

101073.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101073.description:
The tumbled remains of a drystone wall run along one side of this place,
the stones slumped into a long, low mound and overgrown with grass and
bramble. Someone once farmed here, or tried to. The grass towers over
the old wall and leans across the narrow path beside it. The path
follows the wall east and west, and a trail leads north toward a
crossing of game trails.

101074.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101074.description:
The grass stands in thick, rounded tussocks here, each one a small green
tower, and the lanes between them twist and double back on themselves.
Paths open north, south, east and west, though the tussocks make it hard
to keep your bearings. The light flickers as the roof sways, and the
shadows of stems slide to and fro across the floor. The ground between
the tussocks is soft and loamy.

101075.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101075.description:
A huge grey boulder sits half buried in the earth here, crusted with
yellow and orange lichen and warm to the touch. It must have lain here
long before the grass grew, for the stems part around it like water
around a rock in a stream. Scrapes on its flanks show where beasts have
rubbed against it. Paths lead past the boulder north, east, south and
west.

101076.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101076.description:
A dense wall of blackthorn hems in this part of the grass, its black
twigs bristling with long thorns and hung with dusty blue sloes. There
is no way through it. The grass leans against the thorn hedge, forming a
narrow corridor along its foot. The corridor runs east and west, and a
path leads north away from the hedge.

101077.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101077.description:
A well-trodden path leads through the grass here, and the stems along
its sides are bruised and broken by passing feet and hooves. Toward the
road the stalks are still grey with dust, but here they are clean and
green. The path runs west toward Wilderness Way and east deeper into the
grass, while side paths lead north and south.

101078.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101078.description:
The ground here is riddled with tiny runs and holes, and it gives softly
underfoot as though hollow beneath. Narrow tunnels thread through the
matted base of the grass where small creatures come and go unseen.
Above, the stems are tall and tangled together. Paths lead north, east,
south and west over the soft, burrowed earth.

101079.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

101079.description:
A shallow pool of rainwater lies in a clay hollow here, its surface
clouded with fine yellow silt. The grass stands around it in a ring,
reflected upside down in the water. On one side a steep bank of yellow
clay rises out of reach, bound with roots. Paths lead north, east and
south around the edge of the pool.

101080.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101080.description:
The grass hall turns and narrows here, and the roof drops low and dense,
so that the light takes on the colour of pond water. A cairn of piled
stones, knee-high and topped with a flat slab, stands beside the lane
where travellers have each added a pebble for luck. Ways lead north,
south and west. The wind sounds far away, as if the grass had stopped
its ears.

101081.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101081.description:
The grass country ends here in a blind corner, walled by stems so old
and thick that they have grown woody, like a hedge of green canes.
Nothing passes them, and the lanes turn away north and west. A shallow
scrape in the floor holds a bed of dry grass and a few white bones,
gnawed clean. The air is close and smells faintly of musk.

101082.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101082.description:
The wind has laid the grass down here in great swirling whorls, as
though some giant had pressed a hand upon it and turned. The flattened
stems make a springy floor, while the standing grass around the edges
bows and hisses with every gust. The light here is bright and restless.
Paths lead away from the whorls north, east, south and west.

101083.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101083.description:
The last of the grass country thins out here into a ragged hall of
short, straggling stems, with the trunks of great trees showing through
its far wall. A trodden path leads south out of the grass and over open
ground toward the eaves of the Great Forest of MiNar. North, the lane
runs back between the tall stems, and another hall opens west. The air
is cooler and damper here, and smells of the forest.

101084.name: The Grasslands

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101084.description:
This hall of grass is tall and narrow, its stems so straight and high
that the roof seems as far above as the rafters of a temple. Wind howls
through the tops, but at the floor the air barely moves and is close and
warm. Lanes lead east and west, and a way opens south. A rusted plough
blade lies half-buried in the soil, left by some farmer who once tried
to tame this ground and lost.

101085.name: The Grasslands

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101085.description:
An old bank of earth runs along one side of this place, too steep and
overgrown to climb, perhaps the remains of some ancient dyke or
boundary. The grass grows thickly along its top and leans over to form a
dim, green-roofed alley below. The ground is firm and dry. The alley
runs east and west along the foot of the bank, and a narrower path turns
away south.

101086.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101086.description:
The ground grows soft and wet here, and on one side the grass gives way
to a stand of tall reeds rising out of black, sucking mud. A sour,
marshy smell hangs in the air, and the light that comes through the
reeds is grey-green. Firm ground follows the edge of the reeds east and
west, and a drier path leads north back into the grass.

101087.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101087.description:
The wreck of an old cart lies here, its wheels sunk to the hubs in the
earth and its bed rotted through, with grass growing up between the
boards. One shaft still points ahead, as if waiting for a horse that
never came back. Whoever drove it into the grass never drove it out
again. Paths lead past the wreck north, east, south and west.

extra_descs.cart wreck boards tailboard:
The boards are grey and soft with rot, and the iron tyres have rusted
into flaking rings. Burned into the tailboard, barely legible, is a
merchant's mark: a pair of scales above the letter G.

101088.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101088.description:
This is deep in the heart of the Grasslands, and every way looks the
same: tall stems, golden light and a narrow trodden path. The wind
rushes over the grass tops far above, yet down here the air hardly
moves. It would be easy to walk in circles for hours. Identical paths
lead north, east, south and west.

101089.name: The Grasslands

north.description: To the north lies The Grasslands.

east.description: To the east lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies Wilderness Way.

101089.description:
A gap opens in the wall of grass here onto Wilderness Way, and through
it you can glimpse the road and, beyond it, the vast trunk of an
enormous tree. The stems around the gap are dusty and broken by passing
feet. The road lies just to the west, and paths lead north and east into
the dim golden depths of the Grasslands.

101090.name: Obscure Path

east.description: To the east lies Obscure Path.

south.description: To the south lies The Grasslands.

west.description: To the west lies The Grasslands.

101090.description:
The path threads between stems that have been bent and tied together
overhead with twists of cord, forming a low tunnel that someone keeps in
quiet repair. The floor is beaten hard by many boots, though fresh-cut
grass has been strewn over it to hide the trail. East, the tunnel goes
on toward a smell of woodsmoke and horses, and west it rejoins the open
grass. A gap low in the wall leads south into another hall of grass.

101091.name: Obscure Path

east.description: To the east lies Rahn Mercenary Camp: A Place to Hire.

west.description: To the west lies Obscure Path.

101091.description:
The path runs straight here, roofed with old canvas stretched over a
frame of ash poles and weighted with stones against the wind. Small iron
bells hang on a cord along the roof, placed so that anyone walking
through must brush against them. East, a palisade of sharpened stakes
shows at the end of the tunnel, its gate standing open into the
mercenaries' camp. West, the path leads back into the grass.

101092.name: Rahn Mercenary Camp: A Place to Hire

west.description: To the west lies Obscure Path.

101092.description:
This is the hiring hall of the Rahn Mercenary Camp, a long tent of
patched brown canvas raised on stout poles and floored with rough
planks. A trestle table runs across the far end, its top scarred with
knife cuts and stained with ink and ale, and behind it hangs a banner
showing a black fist gripping a sword. Racks of spears and shields line
the walls, and a board pinned with written contracts leans by the
entrance. The only way out is west, back down the hidden path.

extra_descs.board contracts:
Contracts in many hands are pinned to the board: an escort wanted for a
wool caravan to New Thalos, guards for a warehouse in Port Halyon, two
blades for a season in the hills. The terms are the same on every one:
half paid in advance, half on return, and a tenth to the Rahn company.

643500.name: mercenary rahn sellsword
643500.long_desc: A Rahn mercenary in a scarred leather jerkin waits here, ready to sell his sword to whoever can pay.
643500.description:
He is a hard, weathered man with a close-cropped beard and a nose that
has been broken more than once. A black fist gripping a sword is
stitched on the shoulder of his jerkin, the badge of the Rahn company.
He sizes you up with the calm of someone weighing the price of a job,
not the cost of a fight.

643501.name: horse wild dun
643501.long_desc: A dun wild horse crops the grass stems here, its ears turning at every sound.
643501.description:
The horse is small and sturdy, sandy brown with a dark stripe down its
back and a black, ragged mane. Burrs are tangled in its tail, and its
hooves are worn round from the hard ground of the grass country. It
watches you with one rolling eye, ready to bolt.

643502.name: wolf prairie tawny
643502.long_desc: A tawny prairie wolf slinks low between the grass stems, watching you.
643502.description:
This wolf is lean and long-legged, its coat the colour of dry grass so
that it all but vanishes among the stems. Its ears are large and its
muzzle narrow, and a ridge of darker fur bristles along its spine. It
moves with the patience of a hunter that has learned to wait for the
herd to stray.

643503.name: stag red deer
643503.long_desc: A red stag lifts its antlered head from browsing and regards you warily.
643503.description:
The stag stands tall at the shoulder, its coat a deep russet and its
neck thick with a shaggy mane. Its antlers branch into many tines,
rubbed clean and pale at the points. Its nostrils flare as it tests the
air for your scent.

643504.name: wolf timber grey
643504.long_desc: A grey timber wolf pads silently between the trees, its hackles raised.
643504.description:
The wolf is big and heavy-shouldered, its thick grey coat darkening to
black along the back. Old scars cross its muzzle, and its yellow eyes
hold you without blinking. Somewhere in the trees behind it, others of
its pack are surely waiting.

643505.name: owlbear beast bear owl
643505.long_desc: A shaggy owlbear rears up among the trees, its hooked beak clacking.
643505.description:
The owlbear has the hulking body of a bear covered in a mix of coarse
brown fur and ragged feathers, and the round, staring head of a great
owl. Its beak is hooked and yellow, and its forepaws end in claws as
long as daggers. It reeks of blood and rotting leaves, and its hooting
growl is the most terrible sound in the forest.

643506.name: horse wild dun
643506.long_desc: A shaggy dun horse stands among the tall stems, its ears flicking at every rustle.
643506.description:
A stocky wild horse with a coat the colour of dry grass, a dark stripe
down its spine and a coarse black mane that falls over its eyes. Its
unshod hooves are chipped from the hard ground, and burrs are knotted in
its tail. It watches you with one wary eye, ready to wheel and crash
away through the grass.

643507.name: wolf prairie tawny
643507.long_desc: A tawny prairie wolf slinks low through the grass, its yellow eyes fixed on you.
643507.description:
A lean, long-legged wolf, smaller than its cousins of the deep woods,
with a sandy coat that vanishes against the dry stems. Its ribs show
under its pelt and its narrow muzzle is seamed with old scars. The packs
follow the wild horses through the tall grass, but a lone traveller will
do just as well.

643508.name: stag deer red antlered
643508.long_desc: A great red stag lifts its antlered head from the ferns and watches you.
643508.description:
A powerful stag with a russet coat, a shaggy ruff about its neck and a
crown of antlers branching into a dozen tines. Shreds of velvet still
hang from them where it has frayed them on the saplings. It stands
utterly still, nostrils flaring, poised to bound away between the
trunks.

643509.name: owlbear bear owl
643509.long_desc: A hulking owlbear tears at a rotten log with its claws, hooting deep in its chest.
643509.description:
A monstrous beast with the body of a great brown bear and the head of an
owl, its round amber eyes unblinking above a hooked beak big enough to
crush a skull. Coarse fur on its shoulders shades into stiff grey
feathers about its face, and its forepaws end in hooked claws as long as
daggers. It reeks of carrion and wet feathers.

643510.name: sprite woodland fey
643510.long_desc: A woodland sprite flits between the trunks, trailing a faint green glimmer.
643510.description:
A slight, winged figure no taller than your knee, with skin the colour
of new leaves and hair like a tangle of moss. Its wings are veined like
beech leaves and hum softly as it hovers. It regards you with black,
laughing eyes, far more curious than afraid.

643511.name: hunter deer man woodsman
643511.long_desc: A weathered deer hunter crouches here, reading the ground for tracks.
643511.description:
A lean, sun-browned man in patched greens and browns, with a longbow
slung across his back and a knife with a handle of polished antler at
his belt. His pale eyes are narrowed from years of watching for movement
at the edge of sight. He nods to you without a word and goes back to
studying the signs in the earth.

643512.name: owlbear bear owl moss-backed
643512.long_desc: A moss-backed owlbear rakes the bark of a tree with its hooked claws, hooting low in its chest.
643512.description:
It is as big as a brown bear and built like one, but its head is an
owl's, with a heavy hooked beak and round amber eyes that never seem to
blink. Its feathers and fur are matted green with moss and lichen from
years in the damp western woods, so that it can stand among the trees
almost unseen. Each forepaw ends in claws as long and curved as sickles.

643513.name: spider giant mist forest
643513.long_desc: A giant mist spider clings motionless to a dew-hung web between two trunks.
643513.description:
Its body is as big as a hound's, mottled grey and white like lichen on
