wet bark, and its eight long legs are banded and bristling with stiff
hairs. It spins where the mist lies thickest, so that the dew hides its
strands until something blunders into them. A cluster of glossy black
eyes sits above fangs beaded with clear venom.

643514.name: wolf timber grey
643514.long_desc: A grey timber wolf pads silently between the trees, nose low to the ground.
643514.description:
A lean, long-legged wolf with a thick grey coat brindled black along the
spine and a ruff of paler fur at the throat. Its yellow eyes take in
everything at once, and it moves with the patient ease of a hunter that
has followed deer through these woods all its life. Old scars from
hooves and antlers cross its muzzle.

643515.name: sprite woodland fey
643515.long_desc: A woodland sprite flits among the ferns, trailing a faint green glimmer.
643515.description:
A slender figure no taller than your knee, with skin the pale green of
new beech leaves and hair like a tangle of moss and tiny white flowers.
Its wings are as thin as a dragonfly's and beat too fast to see, humming
softly. It watches you with bright, curious, entirely unafraid eyes, and
laughs at nothing in a voice like water over stones.

643516.name: stag deer russet red
643516.long_desc: An old russet stag lifts his antlered head from the ferns and watches you warily.
643516.description:
A great red deer with a coat the colour of autumn bracken and a dark,
shaggy mane about his neck. His antlers branch into a dozen tines,
polished pale at the tips from rubbing against saplings, and the scars
of old rutting fights crisscross his shoulders. He stands utterly still,
ready to bolt at the first wrong move.

643517.name: poacher man deer
643517.long_desc: A deer poacher crouches in the bracken at the forest's edge, an arrow nocked on his bowstring.
643517.description:
A weather-beaten man in a mottled green cloak, his face smeared with mud
and his hair tied back with a strip of hide. A longbow of yew rests in
his hands and a quiver of goose-fletched arrows hangs at his hip, beside
a skinning knife with an antler handle. He has the wary, flat stare of
someone who has been hunted himself, and he does not like to be seen.

743500.name: jerkin leather mercenary rahn
743500.room_desc: A mercenary's leather jerkin lies here in a heap.
743500.description: A sleeveless jerkin of thick boiled leather, scarred by old blade cuts and patched at one side. A black fist gripping a sword is stitched on the shoulder.

743501.name: knife antler-handled antler
743501.description: A broad-bladed knife with a grip cut from the tine of a MiNar stag's antler, smoothed by long handling. The Rahn mercenaries carve these in idle hours at camp.

743502.name: claw owlbear hooked
743502.room_desc: A long, hooked claw lies here, crusted with dried blood.
743502.description: A black claw as long as a dagger, curved like a sickle and still sharp at the point. Hunters and trophy dealers pay well for such proof of an owlbear slain.

743503.name: pelt wolf tawny fur
743503.room_desc: A tawny wolf pelt lies here, rolled up loosely.
743503.description: The pelt of a prairie wolf, coarse and the colour of dry grass. A furrier would give a fair price for it.

743504.name: venison haunch meat
743504.room_desc: A haunch of venison lies here.
743504.description: A dark, lean haunch of red deer, rich-smelling and heavy. It would make a fine meal roasted over a fire.

743505.name: claw owlbear hooked
743505.room_desc: A hooked black claw as long as a dagger lies here.
743505.description: A curved black claw torn from the forepaw of an owlbear, as long as your hand and sharp enough to score oak. Hunters and alchemists in Garathorm pay well for such trophies.

743506.name: knife antler handled hunting
743506.room_desc: A hunting knife with a handle of polished antler lies here.
743506.description: A broad-bladed hunting knife with a handle cut from a stag's antler tine, polished smooth and dark by years of use. The blade is thin from honing but wickedly keen, made for skinning as much as for fighting.

743507.name: sprig heartwood minar twig charm
743507.room_desc: A small sprig of golden wood, still bearing three green leaves, lies here.
743507.description: A slender twig of pale golden wood from the living heart of one of MiNar's great trees, still bearing three green leaves that never wilt. It is warm to the touch and smells of sap and rain, and a leather thong is knotted about it so that it can be worn.

743508.name: pelt wolf tawny fur hide
743508.room_desc: A tawny wolf pelt lies here in a dusty heap.
743508.description: The sandy, coarse-haired pelt of a prairie wolf, roughly skinned and smelling strongly of grass and beast. Its colour would hide a hunter well in the tall grass, and a furrier would pay a few coins for it.

743509.name: venison smoked strip meat
743509.room_desc: A strip of dark smoked venison lies here, wrapped in a dock leaf.
743509.description: A long strip of venison smoked dark over a slow fire of oak chips and rubbed with salt and juniper. It is as tough as leather and tastes of woodsmoke.

743510.name: claw owlbear hooked black
743510.room_desc: A hooked black owlbear claw, as long as a dagger, lies here.
743510.description: Curved like a sickle and as long as a dagger, this black claw was torn from the forepaw of an owlbear, and a few moss-stained feathers still cling to its root. Trappers and charm-makers pay well for such trophies, and its point is still sharp enough to draw blood.

743511.name: skein silk spider grey
743511.room_desc: A skein of fine grey spider silk lies here in a loose coil.
743511.description: A loose coil of grey spider silk, faintly sticky and cool to the touch, finer than any thread a spinner could twist yet strong enough to bear a man's weight. Bowyers prize it for bowstrings, and healers for binding wounds.

743512.name: sprig heartwood minar charm thong
743512.room_desc: A sprig of dark, polished heartwood lies here, still bearing a single green leaf.
743512.description: A short twig of wood so dark and hard that it gleams like old bronze, cut from the heart of some ancient MiNar oak and bound to a thong of plaited grass for wearing at the throat. Though it was cut long ago, a single green leaf still grows from its tip, and it always smells faintly of rain on moss.

743513.name: knife antler antler-handled skinning
743513.room_desc: An antler-handled skinning knife lies here in the leaves.
743513.description: A broad skinning knife with a grip of polished stag antler, the rough crown of the tine left on for a sure hold. The blade has been honed so often that its edge curves like a new moon, and a notch near the hilt is worn bright from cutting sinew.

743514.name: cloak hooded green mottled poacher
743514.room_desc: A hooded cloak of mottled green wool lies here in a heap.
743514.description: A long cloak of oiled wool dyed in blotches of moss green and bracken brown, so that its wearer can lie unseen among the ferns. The hood is deep, and loops sewn along the hem hold sprigs of heather and fern for better hiding.
